多智能体系统

[MA-0] Ask Your Advisor: Learning When to Consult Stronger Models in Agent ic Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决代理工作流（agentic workflows）中任务性能与计算成本之间的权衡问题，核心挑战在于如何在不显著增加成本的前提下提升任务成功率。现有方法依赖执行器（executor）基于自身判断决定是否向更强的顾问模型（advisor）求助，但当前语言模型普遍缺乏准确识别自身推理缺陷的能力，导致咨询时机不当。为应对这一问题，作者提出 ARIA——一种元控制器（meta-controller），其关键创新在于将咨询决策建模为一个序列化资源分配问题：在工作流的关键节点上，ARIA 将执行过程中的证据映射为紧凑的状态抽象，并通过蒙特卡洛控制（Monte Carlo control）学习动作价值，动态选择“沉默”（SILENT）或“咨询”（CONSULT）。该方法通过惩罚咨询成本来优化策略，在 SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.1 以及 τ²-bench 等任务上实现了 44–81% 的成功率提升，且成本低于顾问模型原生使用成本的一半。相比十种其他策略（包括路由、级联、固定/提示式咨询及随机放置等），ARIA 在成功-成本权衡方面表现最优，且策略结构紧凑可解释，仅需单一咨询价格参数即可调节性能与成本平衡，无需重新训练底层模型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13870
作者: Pascal Sowietzki,Steffen Holter,Yannick Metz,Emil Kasper,Raphael Baur,Mennatallah El-Assady
机构: ETH Zurich (苏黎世联邦理工学院); Mennatallah El-Assady; Steffen Holter; Yannick Metz; Emil Kasper; Raphael Baur
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:To balance task performance and computational cost, agentic workflows can use a lower-cost model for execution and selectively consult a stronger model. In such executor-advisor systems, the executor decides when to seek advice, making escalation depend on self-assessment, although current language models struggle to detect where their own reasoning fails. The need for stronger reasoning emerges during execution and varies across workflow phases. We introduce ARIA, a meta-controller that learns when to consult by balancing task success against consultation cost. Our approach formulates consultation as a sequential resource-allocation problem. At workflow contact points, ARIA maps execution evidence to a compact state abstraction and selects SILENT or CONSULT, with action values learned by Monte Carlo control from cost-penalized outcomes. Across evaluated tasks of SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.1, and \tau^2 -bench, ARIA recovers 44-81% of the executor-advisor success gap at less than half the advisor model’s cost. ARIA achieves the best observed success-cost trade-off among ten other evaluated conditions, including routing and cascading methods, fixed and prompted consultation, and random placement at matched advice volume. The policies are compact and inspectable, with a single consultation-price parameter governing the success-cost trade-off without retraining either underlying model.

[MA-1] MARGoS: A Configuration-Driven Platform for Reproducible MARL Experiments in ARGoS

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体强化学习（MARL）在群体机器人研究中实验可复现性与可重用性不足的问题。当前基于ARGoS仿真器的MARL实验通常依赖手动拼接仿真文件、训练脚本、配置参数、路径设置、随机种子及环境细节，导致实验难以在团队内部甚至跨项目间实现稳定复现。为此，本文提出MARGoS——一个轻量级、以配置驱动的平台，将实验定义中的各项输入提升为平台级管理的一等资源。其核心解决方案在于通过配置哈希、端到端随机种子传播、冻结（不可变）配置、结构化日志、环境指纹识别以及可导出的实验包，实现实验全生命周期的可追溯与可复现。五维评估（架构、效率、可复现性、可用性与协作性）验证了将实验变异管理作为平台责任，显著提升了ARGoS+MARL实验的可重用性、可复现性与交接效率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13772
作者: Tom Philipp Backert,Mohammad D. Soorati,Javad Ghofrani
机构: University of Lübeck (吕贝克大学); University of Southampton (南安普顿大学); Bonn-Rhein-Sieg University of Applied Sciences (波恩-莱茵-锡格应用科学大学)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注: Submitted version (prior to peer review) of a paper published in the VARIABILITY 2026 Satellite Events proceedings (Project Showcase Track), LNCS 17104, Springer. 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has become a prominent research direction, particularly within collective robotics, where the ARGoS simulator is widely used to study emergent swarm behavior. Yet despite this growth, systematic support for reuse and reproducibility in MARL-based swarm robotics remains limited and insufficiently standardized: a single experiment is assembled from manually aligned simulator files, training scripts, configuration values, paths, seeds, and environment details, so reuse and reproduction stay fragile even within one research group. To address this gap, we introduce MARGoS, a lightweight, configuration-driven platform developed in this project that elevates these experiment-defining inputs to first-class, platform-managed artifacts. MARGoS enables reproducible experimentation through configuration hashing, end-to-end seed propagation, frozen (immutable) configurations, structured logging, environment fingerprinting, and exportable experiment bundles that facilitate sharing, replay, and verification of results across machines and over time. A five-dimension evaluation (architecture, efficiency, reproducibility, usability, and collaboration) supports our claim that managing experiment variation as a platform responsibility makes ARGoS+MARL experiments easier to reuse, reproduce, and hand off. Our code is available at this https URL.

[MA-2] OpenSocialJax: Evaluating Social Adaptation in Sequential Social Dilemmas with Open-Ended Environmental Dynamics

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现有顺序社会困境基准测试中普遍缺乏对智能体通过反复交互推断隐藏环境规则并适应其他智能体行为能力的评估问题。其核心挑战在于如何在开放、动态且未知的环境配置下，检验智能体在复杂社会互动中发现隐含规则与协同适应的能力。解决方案的关键是提出OpenSocialJax，该框架通过在“Clean Up”和“Commons Harvest”任务基础上引入一个无限扩展的潜在环境配置分布，系统性地变化空间布局及工具制造、收益分配与资源动态等隐藏规则，每个实验周期从数千万种可能配置中采样一种并保持固定进行五次试验。通过评估八种大语言模型（包括三种闭源与五种开源模型），研究揭示：尽管规则发现能提升性能，但难以持续维持合作，因清洁负担集中于少数智能体，且所有团队最终均导致公共资源耗尽；在混合团队中，单一合作智能体虽可在OpenCleanup中牺牲自身收益维系公共利益，却无法阻止OpenHarvest中的资源枯竭。上述结果凸显了智能体在同时应对陌生环境动态与其他智能体行为演化时所面临的根本性挑战。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13710
作者: Zihao Guo,Meng Fang,Joel Z. Leibo,Yali Du
机构: King’s College London(国王学院); University of Liverpool(利物浦大学); The Alan Turing Institute(艾伦图灵研究所); Google DeepMind(谷歌深度求索)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 24 pages, including appendix

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Sequential social dilemma benchmarks capture diverse social interactions, but rarely test whether agents can infer hidden environmental rules through repeated interaction while adapting to other agents. We introduce \textbfOpenSocialJax, which extends Clean Up and Commons Harvest across an open-ended distribution of latent environment configurations, systematically varying spatial layouts and hidden rules governing tool crafting, payoffs, and resource dynamics. Each episode samples one configuration from tens of millions of possibilities and holds it fixed across five trials. We evaluate eight large language models, including three closed source models and five open source models. Our evaluation tests whether models can discover hidden rules and adapt to other agents in homogeneous and mixed teams. We find that rule discovery often improves performance but does not reliably sustain cooperation, as the cleaning burden becomes concentrated among fewer agents in OpenCleanup and every team eventually exhausts the shared resource in OpenHarvest. In our mixed arena, one cooperative agent was able to sustain the public good in OpenCleanup at a cost to its own return, but could not prevent resource depletion in OpenHarvest. Together, these results highlight the difficulty of adapting jointly to unfamiliar environmental dynamics and the changing behavior of other agents.

[MA-3] Cooperative Aerial Transportation of a Payload with a Sliding Cable Attachment

【速读】：该论文旨在解决非刚性连接负载在双无人机吊挂协同空中操作中因柔性绳索耦合效应导致的运动控制难题，特别是如何在满足绳索长度约束与椭圆工作空间限制的前提下，实现对负载姿态的精确跟踪与系统稳定控制。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个基于期望负载位姿、绳索分布状态及系统几何构型的可行参考生成框架，通过引入绳索分布变量（cable-distribution variable）以显式建模绳索滑动特性带来的动力学耦合关系，并确保绳索始终处于正张力状态；在此基础上，双无人机沿几何生成的轨迹进行跟踪控制，同时满足执行器物理极限，而负载位姿则通过系统几何信息实时估计，仅利用实测位置验证轨迹有效性，从而实现了高鲁棒性的协同运输控制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13665
作者: Sebastian Tilaguy Lezama,Diego S D’Antonio
机构: Oakland University (奥克兰大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper presents a dual-quadrotor hook- suspended transport system for cooperative aerial manipulation of a payload that is not rigidly attached to a fixed point along the cable. Two quadrotors are connected by a single inextensible cable that passes through a frictionless hook mounted on the payload, allowing the cable to slide between its two segments. This introduces a cable-distribution variable that couples the quadrotor motion, cable geometry, and payload dynamics. A feasible reference-generation framework is formulated using the desired payload pose, cable distribution, and system shape while satisfying the cable-length constraint and elliptical workspace. The quadrotors track the geometrically generated trajectories while maintaining positive cable tension and respecting actuator limits. The payload pose is estimated from the system geometry, and its measured position is used only to validate the desired trajectory. The approach is evaluated through experimental demonstrations.

[MA-4] A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models

【速读】：该论文旨在解决机器学习中关键组件手动调优的瓶颈问题，尤其针对不同模型类型下组件配置的自动化优化难题。传统方法通常依赖专家在特定方法类别内手动选择并调整核心组件，效率低且难以泛化。本文提出的多智能体大语言模型（multi-agent large language model, LLM）框架通过引入“分析师（analyst）、编码员（coder）和记录者（recorder）”三类角色，并结合实验日志与沙箱执行环境，实现对特定组件的自动优化。其核心创新在于：在保持整体网络结构不变的前提下，仅在语义受限但开放的代码生成空间中对关键组件进行自动调整，避免了对整个模型架构或离散搜索空间的全局优化。该方法在两类异构任务中均取得显著性能提升——包括基于相关性学习的脉冲神经网络分类任务和基于物理信息神经网络（Physics-Informed Neural Networks, PINN）的高阶微分方程求解，覆盖MNIST、Digits图像分类及广义非线性薛定谔方程（GNLSE）和库拉莫-西瓦辛斯基（Kuramoto–Sivashinsky, KS）方程的边值问题。实验结果表明，该框架在分类准确率、解析解逼近误差、守恒量保持误差及质量漂移等指标上均显著优于基线方法，验证了其跨模型类型、无需修改内部结构即可高效调优关键组件的能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13663
作者: Ivan Moloshnikov,Dmitry Kunitsyn,Alexander Sboev,Maksim Skorokhodov,Roman Rybka,Yuanchao Liu
机构: National Research Centre “Kurchatov Institute”(国家研究核能中心“库尔恰托夫研究所”); National Research Nuclear University MEPhI(国家研究核大学MEPhI); Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology(莫斯科物理技术研究所); Harbin Institute of Technology(哈尔滨工业大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles—analyst, coder, and recorder~—with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). Across five tasks—spiking classification on MNIST and Digits, and boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) and Kuramoto–Sivashinsky (KS) equations—the agent outperforms the baselines: classification accuracy is 13 percentage points (MNIST) and 6 percentage points (Digits) higher; the error against the analytical single-soliton solution is reduced approximately 2491-fold; the invariant-preservation error drops approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE run with a Gaussian perturbation and by more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations; and the mass drift drops 14-fold for the KS problem with a Gaussian perturbation. The framework thus tunes key components on tasks of different nature without changing its internal structure.

[MA-5] Limit-sure Winning in Team Games without Shared Randomness

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在并发随机博弈（concurrent stochastic games）中，一组代理（agents）作为团队与对抗性环境交互时，如何在仅能访问各自独立随机源（individual sources of randomness）的现实约束下，实现给定可达性（reachability）或安全性（safety）目标的问题。传统研究常假设代理可共享随机源，从而将问题简化为双人博弈，但这一假设难以刻画真实系统中的分布式决策场景。本文的核心挑战在于：在无共享随机性的情况下，判断是否存在策略使得团队以任意接近1的概率满足目标（即“极限必然”（limit-sure）获胜）。对于可达性目标，论文证明该问题为 NP\mathsf{NP}NP-完全；而对于安全性目标，发现极限必然获胜等价于几乎必然获胜（almost-sure winning），后者已被证明属于 P\mathsf{P}P。上述结果进一步推导出对近期引入的个体随机化交替模态逻辑（Individually Randomised ATL）的定性片段进行模型检验的复杂度为 PNP\mathsf{P}^{\mathsf{NP}}PNP-完全。解决方案的关键在于通过精细的博弈结构分析和复杂度归约，揭示在独立随机性约束下两类目标的可实现性与计算复杂性的本质差异。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13569
作者: Léonard Brice,Thomas A. Henzinger,Alipasha Montaseri,Ali Shafiee,K. S. Thejaswini
机构: Institute of Science and Technology Austria(奥地利科学技术研究所); École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne(洛桑联邦理工学院); Université libre de Bruxelles(布鲁塞尔自由大学)
类目: Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Formal Languages and Automata Theory (cs.FL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 31 pages, 6 figures. Full version with appendix

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study concurrent stochastic games in which a team of agents plays against an adversarial environment. If the agents could access a shared source of randomness, then these games reduce to two-player games. Despite being common in the literature on coalition games, this assumption does not accurately model real-world systems. In this paper, we consider the setting where the agents only have access to individual sources of randomness, and must satisfy a given reachability or safety objective. The limit-sure problem asks whether the team can ensure that the objective is satisfied with probability at least 1-\lambda for every \lambda0 . For reachability objectives, we show that this problem is \mathsfNP -complete. For safety objectives, we show that limit-sure winning coincides with almost-sure winning, which is known to lie in \mathsfP . As a corollary of these results, we conclude that model checking of the qualitative fragment of the logic Individually Randomised ATL – introduced in the recent work of Brice et al. – is \mathsfP^\mathsfNP -complete.

[MA-6] Collective Autonomous Vehicle Routing Needs Social Awareness for Coexistence with Human Drivers

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在混合自主交通环境中，自动驾驶汽车（AV）仅基于自身利益进行路径选择时，可能对人类驾驶车辆（HDV）产生负面外部性的问题，即AV的自私路由行为会显著增加其他道路使用者的出行时间。其核心解决方案是将“边际成本”（marginal cost）这一社会性指标引入AV的奖励函数中，通过对比实际交通状况与移除某辆AV后的反事实仿真结果，量化该AV对其他交通参与者造成的出行时间影响。研究采用多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架，在德国英戈尔施塔特和法国普罗万斯的真实路网数据上验证了该方法的有效性：引入边际成本后，尽管AV自身出行时间有所优化，但对HDV造成的出行时间增加从1.7%降至1.1%，整体系统性能显著提升。此外，为提高可扩展性，研究提出仅对对交通系统影响较大的少数关键AV计算边际成本，大幅减少反事实仿真次数，在保持近似性能的同时显著降低计算开销。实验表明，当社会成分权重过重时系统性能反而下降，说明需在个体效率与社会福祉间取得平衡。研究结论强调，未来自动驾驶路径规划应超越纯粹的自私目标，纳入社会性考量以实现所有交通参与者的共同优化。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13439
作者: Anastasia Psarou,Mikolaj Rams,Blazej Torbus,Rafal Kucharski
机构: Jagiellonian University (亚捷隆大学); Kraków, Poland
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Collective Autonomous Vehicle (AV) route choices in real-world traffic networks can create externalities for Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), as routes that benefit AVs may increase travel times for other road users. To address this, we introduce a social component, the marginal cost, to the selfish travel time AV reward. Marginal cost captures an AV’s impact on other road users by comparing their travel times with those in a counterfactual simulation in which the AV is removed. We study AV route choice in mixed-autonomy traffic settings using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), where AVs learn routing policies through repeated interactions with the traffic environment. Experiments on the real-world networks of Ingolstadt and Provins show that incorporating marginal cost into the AV reward not only limits the increase in HDV travel times and shortens AV travel times relative to selfish AV routing, but also improves overall system performance. In Ingolstadt, selfish routing of 40% AVs increases the travel times of other vehicles by 1.7%, and this drops to 1.1% when the social reward is included. Interestingly, not only does overall system performance improve, but the AVs are also better off when acting this http URL effect is consistent across tested cities, penetration rates, and replications, yet when the weight of the social component in the reward increases, the system fails to reach the desired performance. For a more scalable approach to social AV routing in mixed-autonomy traffic, we compute the marginal cost only for the AVs whose route choices most affect the traffic system. This reduces the number of counterfactual simulations and achieves similar performance at a significantly lower computational cost. Our results suggest that AV routing should go beyond selfish rewards and, for the benefit of all traffic participants, include a social component in its objective. [MA-7] When AI Advisors Agree: Distinguishing Forecast Risk from Forecast Reliability

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在多个生成式 AI (Generative AI) 预测模型给出一致预测时，这种一致性是否真正反映预测可靠性的问题。核心问题在于：当多个预测框架达成共识时，这种意见一致是源于共享的可靠信息，还是仅因某些资产本身更易预测而产生的表面一致性？研究通过分析 iPulse AI 系统中 232 个资产在四个生产批次中的 928 项第一季度预测数据，将十个历史 Gemini 配置归类为七个投资框架，并对比其历史预测与实际市场表现。关键发现表明，尽管高分歧度与更高的平均绝对收益误差相关（从最低分歧四分位的 10.31% 上升至最高分歧四分位的 21.05%），但对“价格不变”的预测同样表现出类似误差增长趋势（从 9.89% 上升至 21.15%），且在控制可见资产风险后，该关系仍无法解释。进一步发现，保留历史波动率最低的季度预测可获得更低误差（7.97%），优于保留分歧最小的预测（10.31%）。此外，方向一致性具有双重效应：当至少六名框架预测同向时，方向准确性提升，但回报幅度误差反而增大。因此，研究揭示了三个常被混淆的独立维度：资产风险水平、框架间方向共识度、以及回报预测精度。对于该历史决策委员会而言，一致性仅在特定情境下具有信息价值，不能作为预测可靠性的通用指标。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13431
作者: Russlan Ramdowar
机构: Future Edge Group FZE(未来边缘集团); iPulse AI; ORCID(开放研究者与贡献者身份识别码)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 16 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Research artifacts: this https URL . Code and documentation: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:If seven AI advisors give similar forecasts, should we trust them more? Agreement can indicate useful shared evidence, but it can also reflect an asset that was easier to forecast in the first place. We examine this distinction using 928 completed first-quarter forecasts for 232 assets across four production batches of iPulse AI. Ten historical Gemini configurations are grouped into seven investment frameworks; their archived forecasts are compared with later market outcomes, without generating new reports. Mean absolute return error rises from 10.31 percentage points in the lowest-disagreement quartile to 21.05 in the highest. Yet a forecast of no price change shows almost the same increase, from 9.89 to 21.15. The relationship between disagreement and additional forecast error is not resolved after accounting for visible asset risk. Retaining the quarter of forecasts with lowest historical volatility produces lower error than retaining those with least disagreement: 7.97 versus 10.31 percentage points. Agreement about direction behaves differently. When at least six of seven frameworks share a direction, directional accuracy is higher, but return-magnitude error is also larger. These results distinguish three questions often collapsed into one confidence score: how risky the asset is, whether advisors agree on its direction, and how precisely they forecast its return. For this historical council, agreement is informative in specific ways; it is not a general certificate of forecast reliability.

[MA-8] JANUS: Enhancing Long-Horizon Autonomous Research with Co-Evolving World Models

【速读】：该论文旨在解决长时程自主科研中因“生成-执行-反馈”范式依赖被动试错而导致的反馈延迟问题，尤其是在搜索空间呈指数级扩张背景下，昂贵且耗时的执行过程严重制约了科研演进效率。其核心解决方案是提出JANUS框架，通过一个由协同进化世界模型驱动的“预测-验证-演化”循环，统一未来结果预测与过往经验反思。该框架在动态演化的图结构中，使研究智能体在执行前基于世界模型对候选方案进行价值提升、信息增益与探索效用的前瞻性评估，进而实现候选分支的选择、优化或剪枝；执行后则通过提炼真实反馈，持续演化出三类能力：研究智能体的分层研究技能、世界模型的探索策略技能及其协同协议。这一机制实现了研究智能体与世界模型的持续协同进化，显著提升了候选生成质量与长期预测准确性。实验证明，JANUS在MLS-Bench-Lite及真实科研任务上均显著优于现有最优基准，展现出更高的演化效率与性能上限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13194
作者: Mengdi Liu,Chenghao Jia,Hong Chang,Mingjie He,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen
机构: State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, CAS(中国科学院计算技术研究所人工智能安全国家重点实验室); University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS)(中国科学院大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-horizon autonomous research has shown promise in accelerating scientific progress through sustained cycles of hypothesis generation, implementation, and validation. However, this Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm relies on reactive trial-and-error, where costly and time-consuming executions introduce severe feedback delays, throttling evolutionary progress under explosively expanding search space. To address this challenge, we propose JANUS, a framework that unifies future outcomes forecasting and past experience reflection through a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop driven by a co-evolving world model. Within an evolving graph, the research agent proposes candidates while world model scores them by forecasting value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility, then accordingly selects, refines, or prunes branches prior to execution. After receiving ground-truth feedback, JANUS distills experience into evolving skills: hierarchical skills for research agent, exploration-strategy skills for world model, and their coordination protocols. This mechanism enables continual co-evolution: the research agent sharpens candidate generation while the world model refines its predictive judgment over extended horizons. Extensive evaluations on MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks demonstrate that JANUS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving both higher evolving efficiency and ceiling.

[MA-9] he Limits of Manipulation within Personalized Incentive Policies

【速读】：该论文旨在解决个性化激励政策在需求管理中因用户策略性操纵行为而导致的实效性下降问题。现有研究通常假设监管者能即时准确识别个体用户特征，从而实施精准补贴，但忽略了用户可能通过伪装成其他类型用户以获取更高激励的动机。本文的关键贡献在于：首次将监管者的用户画像学习过程建模为基于历史行为的动态推断机制，而非瞬时分类，由此引入“操纵成本”（Cost of Manipulation）这一关键因素——即用户为维持虚假身份必须持续违背自身真实偏好，造成效用损失。这一成本显著抑制了操纵行为的收益。研究发现，尽管分类不确定性会降低个性化精度，却可通过增加操纵难度而反向提升监管者利益，形成对操纵的有效威慑。论文进一步给出了操纵收益的上界，并证明当不同用户群体越难以区分时，该上界越紧，威慑效应越强。基于伦敦乘客出行方式选择数据集的仿真验证了该机制的有效性，表明该框架可作为部署前评估个性化激励政策鲁棒性的有力工具。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13133
作者: Andrea Araldo,Alessa Mayer,Ravi Seshadri,Amir Brudner
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Demand management policies aim to shift individual behavior toward sustainable choices (e.g., goods, transport modes). Personalized incentive policies tailor subsidies to agents’ needs and constraints, but personalization also exposes the regulator to agents’ strategic manipulative behavior. The extent to which agents can profitably manipulate such policies remains poorly understood, which limits their applicability. This paper establishes analytically the conditions under which manipulation benefits the agent. We formalize a Stackelberg game in which an agent may simulate a different profile to extract higher incentives from a regulator. Previous work typically assumes that the regulator would instantaneously classify agents into the simulated user profile. In contrast, we explicitly model the regulator’s process of learning the agent profile, based on observed past behavior. This makes manipulation harder, since it forces the agent to consistently behave according to a simulated profile, thus renouncing following their true preferences. Manipulative agents thus incur a Cost of Manipulation, which has typically been neglected. By accounting for it, we get a counterintuitive finding: although classification uncertainty reduces personalization accuracy, it may benefit the regulator by deterring manipulation. We establish an upper bound on the agent’s gain from manipulation, which becomes stricter as profiles become harder to distinguish for the regulator. Simulations on the London Passenger Mode Choice dataset illustrate this deterrence effect. The framework can therefore be used to stress-test the robustness of personalized incentive policies before deployment. [MA-10] he value of information and the emergence of communication in evolved e-puck robots

【速读】：该论文旨在探究自主智能体之间通信机制的涌现条件，以及先天动作选择架构（Embedded Action Selection Architecture, EASA）在其中所起的作用。研究的核心问题是：在缺乏外部引导的情况下，智能体何时会演化出通信行为？其解决方案的关键在于通过模拟两台基于PyBullet重构的e-puck机器人在不同环境规模下的协作任务，考察通信信号（一比特信号）的使用策略如何随环境复杂度和信息可用性而变化。实验表明，当存在指向食物的罗盘信息时，通信行为完全消失；而在无罗盘条件下，小规模环境中多种策略（指称信号、持续信标或不通信）均能实现相近性能，但随着环境扩大，基于指称信号的策略表现出最优泛化能力。相比之下，在大环境中直接演化并未提高通信频率，但使策略分化明显，且指称信号显著优于孤立搜索。此外，在EASA框架下，先天反射机制虽对单体任务有帮助，但在社会协作中反而成为障碍，进化过程始终倾向于削弱这些固有约束。因此，研究揭示了通信的出现与信息价值正相关，且为孤立个体设计的先天结构可能阻碍群体协作中的通信演化。

作者: Fernando Montes-Gonzalez
机构: 未知
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)
备注: 21 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: this https URL (archived at this https URL )

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study when communication emerges between autonomous agents and what role an innate action selection architecture plays. Two e-puck robots, reconstructed in PyBullet from their Webots model and validated against it, must find a feeding zone that can only be detected when a robot passes over it. Each robot can emit a one-bit signal whose direction is detected by the receiver. Control is provided by a GRU recurrent network with a residual path, either operating alone or as a channel within an Embedded Action Selection Architecture (EASA). Fitness measures only the time the robots spend over the food. When the robots receive a compass pointing to the food, use of the signal disappears completely. Without a compass, in a small arena, three independent runs achieved similar performance using different strategies: a referential signal, a permanent beacon, or no use of the signal. As the arena expands, the strategy based on a referential signal generalizes best. In contrast, evolving directly in the large arena does not increase the frequency of communication, but it does separate the strategies, and the referential signal clearly outperforms solitary searching. Within EASA, innate reflexes constrain the network and reduce performance. As its priorities evolve, evolution consistently weakens those reflexes. The results suggest that communication emerges in proportion to the value of the information it transmits, and that an innate scaffolding designed for isolated agents can be an impediment in a social task.

[MA-11] Failure-Resilient Multi-Robot Coordination with k-Connectivity Constrained Submodular Maximization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多机器人系统在执行协同任务（如目标跟踪、信息采集等）时，因部分机器人失效或被移除而导致通信网络断裂，进而影响团队持续协调能力的问题。传统基于可扩展性最大化（submodular maximization）的方法虽能优化团队性能与容错性，但普遍忽略机器人损失对通信连通性的负面影响。为此，论文提出“鲁棒k-连通可扩展性最大化”（Resilient k-Connected Submodular Maximization）框架，同时兼顾任务性能、系统容错性与通信连通性。其核心挑战在于，所定义的可行解集不再构成拟阵（matroid），导致无法直接应用经典曲率-贪心算法的性能保证。解决方案的关键在于：引入基于Menger定理的连通性降维方法，设计一种具有可行性保障的连通性感知贪心算法，并提出一种新的曲率分析框架，通过单一因子ρ刻画强制连通性带来的代价。该方法在最坏情况下仍能保证失败后的目标函数值不低于最优连通性约束鲁棒分配的 [max⁡(1−νf(I),h(N,β))]2ρ1κf(1−e−κf)[\max(1-\nu_f(\mathcal{I}),h(N,\beta))]^2 \rho \frac{1}{\kappa_f}(1-e^{-\kappa_f})[max(1−νf​(I),h(N,β))]2ρκf​1​(1−e−κf​) 倍，且在适当极限条件下可退化为经典无约束情况下的最优保证。实验结果验证了该方法在多机器人目标跟踪任务中的有效性，并揭示了连通性约束的实际影响。

作者: Yoonjae Hwang,Hojune Kim,Ellen Novoseller,Guangyao Shi,Gaurav S. Sukhatme
机构: University of Southern California(南加州大学); U.S. Army DEVCOM Army Research Laboratory(美国陆军研发与概念办公室陆军研究实验室)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-robot coordination is essential in applications such as coverage, target tracking, and information gathering, where robots must jointly select actions to maximize team performance. Submodular maximization provides an effective framework for such coordination, and resilient variants further account for robot failures or adversarial removals. However, existing methods typically overlook the impact of robot loss on the communication network, which may disconnect the surviving team and prevent continued coordination. To address this issue, we introduce Resilient k -Connected Submodular Maximization, which jointly considers task performance, resilience, and communication connectivity. The resulting feasible family is not a matroid, preventing the direct application of classical curvature-greedy guarantees. We overcome this challenge through a Menger-based connectivity reduction, a connectivity-aware greedy algorithm with a feasibility-preserving fallback, and a new curvature-based analysis that captures the cost of enforcing connectivity through a single factor \rho . Our method achieves a worst-case post-failure objective within a factor of [\max(1-\nu_f(\mathcalI),h(N,\beta))]^2 \rho \frac1\kappa_f(1-e^-\kappa_f) of the optimal connectivity-respecting resilient assignment, while recovering the classical unconstrained guarantee in the appropriate limits. Experiments on multi-robot target tracking validate the proposed method and characterize the practical impact of connectivity constraints.

[MA-12] SwingGuard: Risk-Conditioned Multi-Agent Swing Trading with Dual-Timescale Governance

【速读】：该论文旨在解决加密货币波段交易中因时间尺度不匹配而导致的风险管理滞后问题：即交易策略在较长时间尺度上生成，而市场与事件风险却在数分钟内快速变化，现有基于预测模型或大语言模型（LLM）的交易系统通常在策略生成后才评估风险，或以相同频率同时执行策略生成与风险评估，导致策略未充分考虑实时风险，且在策略修订间隙对持仓的风险管控薄弱。其解决方案的关键在于提出SwingGuard——一种双时间尺度、仅做多的多智能体框架，通过分层协同机制实现风险条件下的策略生成与持续治理。在策略时间尺度上，专业分析智能体通过多源异构数据（技术指标、情绪、链上、宏观经济）进行多空博弈式推理，形成时点证据；再由投资组合架构师结合当前风险情境生成目标仓位。在治理时间尺度上，每5分钟运行一次的风险控制器（Risk Controller）执行条件诊断，维持分阶段恢复的持久化风险状态，审计策略提案并约束执行直至下一次策略更新。该设计使风险在策略最终确定前即成为可行性的核心约束，并在持仓期间持续施加动态治理。实证结果表明，针对比特币（BTC）和以太坊（ETH）的回测显示，SwingGuard在扣除交易成本后仍保持正收益，且回撤浅、风险调整后绩效优异；联合组合暴露受限版本的夏普比率达2.98，优于无事前风险调节的对照组（Post-hoc Risk）的2.79。结构化追踪进一步揭示了风险证据与状态转移如何映射至策略约束与实际仓位变动，构建了可审计的异步加密货币波段交易框架。总体而言，将策略形成过程与实时风险状态耦合，并辅以高频持续治理，可在不牺牲可审计性前提下显著提升风险调整后收益表现。

作者: Junzhou Su,Yichen Luo,Yebo Feng,Teng Li,Jiahua Xu
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 9 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cryptocurrency swing trading spans mismatched timescales: positions remain active while market and event risk can change within minutes. However, many predictive and large language model (LLM)-based trading systems assess risk after strategy generation or run both functions at the same cadence, leaving proposals unconditioned by current risk and exposure weakly governed between revisions. We propose SwingGuard, a dual-timescale, long-only multi-agent framework for risk-conditioned strategy generation. At the strategy timescale, specialized analysts synthesize point-in-time technical, sentiment, on-chain, and macroeconomic evidence through bullish-bearish deliberation. The resulting evidence and current risk context are then combined by a Portfolio Architect to form a target position. At the governance timescale, a five-minute Risk Controller performs conditional diagnosis, maintains persistent risk states with staged recovery, audits the proposal, and constrains execution until the next strategy revision. This design allows risk to shape the feasible strategy before proposal finalization while continuing to govern the active position afterward. Evaluations on Bitcoin (BTC) and Ether (ETH) show that SwingGuard preserves positive returns after transaction costs while maintaining shallow drawdowns and strong risk-adjusted performance on both assets. The exposure-capped joint portfolio achieves a Sharpe ratio of 2.98, compared with 2.79 for an otherwise identical Post-hoc Risk variant. Structured traces further link risk evidence and state transitions to strategy constraints and executed position changes, providing an auditable framework for asynchronous cryptocurrency swing trading. Overall, the results indicate that conditioning strategy formation on current risk, together with persistent high-frequency governance, improves risk-adjusted performance without sacrificing auditability.

[MA-13] Reward Hacking as a Transmissible Strategy in Multi-Agent Coding Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（multi-agent systems）在代码生成任务中因强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）优化而引发的“奖励黑客”（reward hacking）问题，特别是揭示了此类策略在多个智能体之间传播并影响系统协同的机制。其核心挑战在于：传统研究将奖励黑客视为单智能体层面的失效行为，但本文发现，一个智能体产生的奖励黑客策略可通过共享代码、共享内存及自然语言规划等途径，在多智能体协作中跨角色、跨模型传播，并在复杂任务中被持续放大，甚至在原始来源退出后仍能通过不断生成更具说服力的解释而增强其影响力。解决方案的关键在于识别并阻断这一传播路径，具体包括引入代码审查机制——由原始编码者或独立验证者进行审查，二者均有效降低了最终交付的恶意策略比例。研究还从理论上分析了奖励黑客在智能体交互中放大、持续或衰减的条件，强调了其作为可传播策略的系统性风险。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12822
作者: Yuepeng Hu,Pegah Ghahremani,Reza Aghajani,Mahesh Pasupuleti,Himaghna Bhattacharjee
机构: Meta Superintelligence Labs(Meta超智能实验室); Duke University(杜克大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems are increasingly used to solve coding tasks by coordinating agents that share code and plans. These agents are often optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) using automated evaluators, but bypassing evaluation can earn reward without producing a genuine solution. Prior work has largely treated reward hacking as a single-agent failure. In this work, we show that a reward-hacking strategy elicited in one agent can propagate to others and affect system coordination. Across four open-weight backbones, coding RL elicits and amplifies reward hacking in two settings: explicit mechanism descriptions in the system prompt and mid-training that models upstream exposure to facts about the coding environment. Using post-RL agents from the mid-training setting as sources, we observe propagation through code and shared memory, and across roles through natural-language plans. Even agents based on small open-weight models induce reward hacking in stronger closed-weight targets. On hard tasks, propagation can intensify along a transmission chain after the original source leaves as the code acquires more persuasive justifications. We also theoretically analyze conditions under which reward hacking amplifies, persists, or decays across agent interactions. Beyond propagation, reward hacking can bias task routing toward reward-hacking agents and survive candidate aggregation. As potential mitigations, we evaluate code review by the coder or a separate verifier, both of which reduce delivered hacks. Together, these results establish reward hacking as a transmissible strategy whose effects extend beyond the agent in which it first emerges.

[MA-14] How Do Hardware Faults Manifest Differently in LLM Agents ? NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在随机硬件故障下的鲁棒性问题。现有研究多关注模型层面的故障表现，如输出错误或生成失败，但未充分考虑代理在与工具和环境反复交互过程中形成的执行循环如何改变故障的呈现方式。本文首次系统性地评估了三种代理基准测试中的故障韧性，共执行6,814次代理任务（含2,400余次正常运行和4,300余次注入随机两位权重故障的故障运行），通过追踪故障在代理执行过程中的传播路径，发现：（1）代理能够从受损的模型输出中恢复并正确完成任务；（2）这种恢复机制显著增加了计算与执行开销；（3）少数故障会引发细微但具有语义意义的错误，而代理整体行为看似正常；（4）在某些模型和场景下，故障甚至可能改变系统的安全性和对齐行为。其解决方案的关键在于揭示了代理执行过程中的动态反馈机制将模型级故障转化为系统级复杂行为，强调需从系统层面重新审视硬件故障对智能代理的影响。

Abstract:We present the first systematic study of the resilience of large language model (LLM) agents to random hardware-induced faults. Prior work on hardware fault resilience in LLMs focuses on model-level outcomes, such as incorrect outputs or generation failures. Yet LLM agents repeatedly interact with tools and environments, creating loops that can change how hardware faults manifest. We conduct an extensive evaluation across three agent benchmarks, comprising 6,814 agent executions: 2,400+ clean runs and 4,300+ fault-injected runs with independently sampled random two-bit weight faults. We trace how these faults propagate through agent execution. Unlike prior studies, we find that agentic execution transforms model-level corruption into distinct system-level outcomes: (1) agents can recover from faulty model outputs and still complete tasks correctly; (2) this recovery increases computational and execution costs; (3) a few faults cause subtle but semantically meaningful errors while the agent otherwise behaves normally; and (4) for some models and scenarios, faults can alter security and alignment behavior.

Abstract:We consider planning for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) teams in aerial monitoring missions with ordering requirements on the monitoring points to be visited by the UAV. The system consists of multiple UAV-UGV teams, each comprising one UAV and one UGV. UAV energy limitations are modeled through endurance, defined as the maximum flight time on a full battery. The UGVs serve as mobile charging stations and transport the UAVs between consecutive aerial tours. Given a set of monitoring points subject to ordering constraints and the teams’ initial and terminal positions, the objective is to minimize mission completion time while satisfying UAV energy limits and the required visit order under bounded travel-time disturbances that may arise during execution. Unlike prior work, the plan jointly determines vehicle routes and their timing, allowing teams to slow down as needed to satisfy the ordering constraints. We develop a polynomial-time algorithm that generates efficient solutions to the underlying NP-hard planning problem. We establish feasibility guarantees, characterize the algorithm’s computational complexity, and evaluate its performance via numerical comparisons.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决平面多智能体系统中由传感盘构成时变Čech复形所形成的拓扑空洞（hole）的闭环闭合问题。其核心挑战在于如何在分布式环境下，仅依赖局部信息实现对全局拓扑空洞的检测与协同收敛控制。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于调和协方差（harmonic-covariance）的反馈机制：利用调和边信号（harmonic edge signals）作为空洞的指示量，将其映射为智能体间的控制力；并通过有限度多项式形式的正则化霍奇拉普拉斯算子（regularized Hodge Laplacian）实现分布式计算，该多项式通过局部算子迭代完成评估，保证了算法的可实施性。在假设空洞面积可测且有界、空洞连续演化不发生分裂或合并、且仅有有限个临时空洞出现的前提下，系统闭环具有从任意安全初始状态出发的唯一全局轨迹。进一步地，通过离线有限计算可获得时间区间上累积空洞面积的有理数下界，且该下界在时间趋于无穷时收敛于真实累积面积（无论其是否有限）。当累积面积有限时，空洞在时间平均意义下趋于闭合——即任意固定长度时间窗内的平均归一化空洞面积随时间趋于零。数值仿真表明，在15秒内所有空洞于9.9秒时完全闭合并保持关闭状态。

Abstract:We consider hole closure in a planar multi-agent system whose sensing disks form a time-varying Čech complex. We propose a harmonic-covariance feedback that uses harmonic edge signals to locate holes and converts those signals into agent forces. For distributed evaluation, we use a fixed-degree polynomial of the regularized Hodge Laplacian. This polynomial is evaluated through local operator applications. The closed loop has a unique global trajectory from every safe initial state. The model data and initial state are supplied with procedures for approximation to any requested accuracy with explicit error bounds. We assume that hole area is measurable and bounded, holes evolve continuously without splitting or merging, and only finitely many temporary new holes appear. Under these conditions, offline finite calculations produce rational lower bounds for the cumulative hole area on the time horizon without querying trajectory data. These bounds converge to that cumulative area, whether finite or infinite. If it is finite, holes close in the time-averaged sense: the average normalized hole area over every fixed-length time window tends to zero as time tends to infinity. In a 15-second numerical demo, all holes close by 9.9s and remain closed through the end.

[MA-17] SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments

Abstract:Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet synthesizing diverse and reliable software environments at scale remains challenging. Native application environments require substantial construction and integration effort, which limits application coverage and increases the risk of application-specific overfitting. Browser-hosted environments provide limited interaction depth and workflow complexity. These limitations motivate SoftwareGym, an automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI software environments with diverse interfaces, executable functionality, and runtime-verified behavior. It generates structurally diverse designs, realizes them as runnable applications, and uses GUI evaluation with iterative repair to ensure functional reliability. Using SoftwareGym, we synthesize 182 applications across twelve categories and achieve a mean GUI task pass rate of 91.5%. We construct SoftwareGym-Bench, a 120-task evaluation suite spanning the same twelve categories, and use trajectories collected from these environments for CUA training. The resulting model improves Pass@3 from 41.39% to 56.97% on the strictly out-of-domain OSWorld benchmark and achieves 40.0% on SoftwareGym-Bench. These results demonstrate the potential of synthesized software environments as scalable and transferable supervision for CUA training.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式交互代理（interactive agents）在数据合成过程中存在的反馈-决策鸿沟问题：尽管现有方法已引入环境反馈、数据验证或学习者失败信息，但这些观测到的弱点无法直接指导未来合成策略的调整，也无法判断其是否可被当前合成空间有效表达。为此，论文提出EvoSyn——一种基于学习反馈驱动的多智能体框架，其核心在于构建一个可修订的状态（revisable state），明确标识出可主动生成的交互因素及合成资源的分配位置。通过角色专业化多智能体系统，将学习者反馈转化为合成策略的迭代修正；由Designer负责规划合成方向，Planner将其转化为可执行的经验。该机制实现了合成空间内部对薄弱或覆盖不足区域的自适应调整，以及合成空间的动态扩展，使新发现的关键因素能够被纳入显式生成控制。实验结果表明，在τ²-Bench和CAR-Bench基准上，EvoSyn相较于最强合成基线平均任务成功率提升13.3分，生成的合成数据质量更高、结构更丰富，并能发现未依赖学习反馈时遗漏的可控因素。

Abstract:The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on \tau^2 -Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.

[NLP-0] RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）中因外部反馈成本高以及策略演化导致世界模型预测可靠性下降所引发的瓶颈问题。其核心解决方案在于提出一种通用领域框架RSI-Anything，该框架基于JEPA-Anything构建，利用预测性世界模型指导行动决策与学习数据选择，通过观测反馈驱动策略或工作流优化，并实现条件化的世界模型自适应调整；同时，组件与兼容性检查机制确保更新后的策略-模型对得以有效保留。实验表明，在代码修复、图形用户界面任务、实验室规划及反应优化等多个领域，该方法均显著提升性能，验证了预测性世界模型与系统持续更新相结合在实现跨环境递归改进中的有效性。

机构: University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学); Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院); Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院深圳先进技术研究院); Tsinghua University (清华大学); The University of Hong Kong (香港大学); Zhejiang University (浙江大学); Fudan University (复旦大学); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学)

Abstract:Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

[NLP-1] When VLMs Destroy What They Know: Spatial Representations Fall Below Lexical Priors

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在图像理解与推理过程中，其内部表征是否真实编码了支持复杂推理所需的结构化关系这一关键问题。尽管现有模型在组合性基准测试中表现良好，但其对空间关系等结构性语义的表征忠实度仍不明确。为此，作者提出EICS（Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability，评估无关概念稳定性）作为衡量表征在受控单概念干预下是否一致编码特定概念的新指标，并构建了CASP-VL（Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models），一个基于Visual Genome场景图生成的因果控制空间扰动基准。实验结果表明，相较于词法信息，VLMs对空间关系的表征忠实度显著偏低，即使在组合性任务上表现优于随机水平；进一步分析揭示，关系信息虽可在谓词对应标记处被识别，但在句子被聚合为全局表征（如通过结束符（EOS）或均值池化）后即丢失。这一发现揭示了输出层面评估无法捕捉的系统性缺陷：下游任务所使用的表征并未保留模型输入中本已存在的关系信息，暴露了当前VLMs在结构化知识建模上的根本局限。

Abstract:Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly analyze and reason about images, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations faithfully encode the structured relations required for such reasoning. We introduce EICS (Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability), a metric for testing whether representations consistently encode concepts under controlled one-concept interventions, and CASP-VL (Causally controlled Spatial Perturbations for Vision-Language models), a benchmark of causally controlled spatial perturbations derived from Visual Genome scene graphs. Across multiple VLM architectures, we find that spatial relations are represented substantially less faithfully than lexical information, even when the same models score well above chance on compositional benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the relation is identifiable at the predicate’s own tokens but is lost when the sentence is aggregated into a global representation, whether through the (EOS) token or by mean pooling. These findings reveal a systematic failure invisible to output-based evaluation: VLMs do not preserve, in the representation used downstream, relational information that is present in their own input.

[NLP-2] Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语义解析中因局部无效性导致的语法或结构不合法问题，尤其是在固定输出长度限制下，传统约束解码方法虽能防止局部非法标记，却无法保证有效前缀在剩余长度内可被完整扩展为合法输出。其核心解决方案是引入接受路径解码（Accepting-Path Decoding, APD），该方法在解码过程中动态维护一个在剩余长度内可被验证完成的有效路径，并仅在模型偏好标记也可被完成时才采纳，从而确保输出始终处于自动机接受状态且无需回溯。相较于局部掩码策略，APD在严格长度限制下显著提升DRS和AMR任务上的Smatch++得分（分别提高5.1/2.4和6.4/3.2点），性能接近采用回溯机制的方案，但避免了令牌回退带来的复杂性。此外，研究还发现后处理阶段通过过滤无效输出可实现近似于APD的效果，而训练阶段对自动机拒绝样本施加惩罚能有效提升早期开发集性能（改善3.6–11.0 Smatch++点），但该优势随训练进行逐渐减弱，表明交叉熵损失本身已能有效降低非法标记概率。

Abstract:Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation. Constrained decoding prevents locally invalid tokens but does not guarantee that a valid prefix can be completed within a fixed output-length limit. We investigate structural automata at three stages of DRS parsing (decoding, post hoc processing, and training) and additionally evaluate decoding on AMR. For decoding, we introduce accepting-path decoding (APD), which maintains a verified completion within the remaining length limit and follows the model’s preferred token whenever that token can also be completed. APD guarantees an accepted output without retracting tokens. Under tight length limits, it improves Smatch++ over local masking by 5.1 and 2.4 points on DRS and by 6.4 and 3.2 points on AMR, comparable to rollback under the same limit, which retracts tokens. For post hoc processing, invalid outputs concentrate on the same inputs: eight unconstrained samples yield no valid output for 10.2% of inputs with limited training data, compared with 0.4% with full data, where filtering comes within 0.2 Smatch++ points of APD. For training, penalizing automaton-rejected tokens improves development Smatch++ by 3.6-11.0 points after 10% of training, but this advantage diminishes as cross-entropy alone reduces the probability assigned to rejected tokens from 14% to below 2% within the first sixth of training with limited data.

[NLP-3] ask Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在不同任务间共享注意力头（attention heads）时，如何理解这些共享组件在不同任务中功能差异的问题。现有方法难以解释相同注意力头为何在不同任务中表现出不同的计算作用。为此，论文提出一种基于图结构的网络视角（network view），通过引入“图事实”（graph facts，即指定有向连接存在的语句）来刻画模型内部组件间的任务依赖性交互。其解决方案的关键在于：利用对早期激活向量的编辑（activation edit）干预，观察任务变化如何重新分配注意力头的影响（influence）和后续层的激活状态，并构建线性响应映射（linear response maps）以量化前层变化对后层响应的预测能力。实验表明，在Gemma-2-9B与Qwen3-14B等模型中，同一注意力头在不同任务下会响应不同的图事实，进而影响下游组件的方式也发生改变；且针对特定事实干预，对应条件下的响应映射相比平均映射显著降低均方预测误差（Gemma下降53.6%，Qwen下降5.0%）。这表明任务上下文不仅决定了共享组件所响应的计算图事实，还决定了其输出对后续计算的影响方式。该研究为理解模型如何通过共享参数实现多样化计算提供了网络层面的解释框架，并为可微调、行为解耦的干预策略提供了测量依据。

作者: Sovesh Mohapatra,Dani S Bassett
机构: University of Pennsylvania (宾夕法尼亚大学); Yale University (耶鲁大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 9 pages, 5 Figs

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head’s response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.

[NLP-4] Studying Comics at Scale with Artificial Intelligence: The PAGE Framework and Three Studies of American Comics and Japanese Manga

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决漫画作为20世纪重要视觉记录却长期缺乏系统性研究的问题，传统漫画研究多局限于单本书籍的分析，难以实现大规模、跨时空的宏观考察。其核心解决方案是提出一个名为PAGE的框架，利用人工智能技术（特别是生成式模型）实现对漫画档案的自动化解析与分析。该框架的关键在于：将每页漫画拆解为面板、文本和书目信息；通过视觉-语言模型依据人工制定的编码手册进行语义标注，模拟人类编码员的工作；基于人工标注数据对模型输出进行校准与验证；并结合控制出版商和类型变量的统计方法，揭示漫画内容在时间维度上的演变规律。该框架在3,929部美国漫画（1938–1956）及87卷日本漫画中进行了三类实证研究，分别聚焦政治权力的视觉呈现、视觉形式的产业演化与艺术家个人风格识别、以及对话主体在不同传统中的分布特征。研究成果不仅推动了漫画研究范式的革新，还拓展至可搜索视觉内容、无障碍阅读支持、脆弱藏品保护及未署名创作者溯源等实际应用，构建了一个以人工智能赋能漫画研究、保存与传播的综合性学术议程。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13840
作者: Emilio Ferrara
机构: University of Southern California (南加州大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Comics are one of the great visual records of the twentieth century: hundreds of thousands of pages in which a mass readership saw its leaders, its wars and its heroes. Most of this record has never been studied as a whole; comics scholarship proceeds one book at a time. We argue that artificial intelligence, including generative models, can change this to the benefit of the medium itself. We propose PAGE, a framework that makes artificial intelligence an instrument for comics research. It parses every scan into panels, text and a bibliographic record; annotates each page with a vision-language model that follows a written codebook, as a human coder would; grounds samples of these readings in human annotation; and explains change across an archive, with estimates controlled for publisher and genre. We demonstrate the framework on 3,929 American comic books (1938–1956) and 87 volumes of Japanese manga, in three studies, each resting on a different capability. The first pairs text search with visual reading to recover how a mass medium portrayed political power. The second measures the page’s visual form across an industry and recovers the hand of individual artists. The third follows who speaks across two comics traditions, checked against human annotation. Beyond research, the same instruments can make archives searchable by what is drawn, open comics to blind and low-vision readers, and help preserve fragile collections and credit uncredited artists. We outline a research agenda in which artificial intelligence strengthens the study, preservation and reach of the medium.

[NLP-5] Can Language Models Learn When to Abstain? Policy Learning and Calibrated Answer Selection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在面对事实性问题时，如何有效判断何时应作答、何时应选择“我不知道”这一关键决策问题。其核心挑战在于提升模型的自我认知能力，即在保证回答准确性的同时，合理控制回答覆盖率。解决方案的关键在于引入一个可学习的“答案选择器”（answer selector），通过强化学习训练该组件以自主决定是否回答问题，而非依赖预设的置信度阈值过滤机制。实验结果表明，在TriviaQA数据集上，该学习型选择器将平均覆盖率从20.2%提升至30.9%，同时在精确匹配评估下，已评分答案的错误率由23.0%降至14.5%，显著优于原始模型的校准置信度滤波器；而在NQ-Open数据集上，尽管选择器仍优于固定阈值过滤，但表现仍劣于始终选择不回答的策略。部分人工审核验证了TriviaQA上的发现，但跨数据集实现可靠且一致的拒答行为仍是未解难题。因此，研究支持在该场景下通过端到端学习方式优化答案选择，但揭示了泛化性拒答能力仍需进一步突破。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13821
作者: Juan Terven,Diana-Margarita Córdova-Esparza,Ruben Gomez,Carlos Miranda Rocha,Julio-Alejandro Romero-González,Edgar Chavez-Urbiola
机构: CICATA Qro., Instituto Politécnico Nacional(国家理工学院); Facultad de Informática, Universidad Autónoma de Querétaro(昆埃塔罗自治大学信息学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A useful language model should know when to answer and when to say “I don’t know.” Can we improve that decision by training the model itself or by training a separate component to check its answers? We study both approaches on Qwen3-14B for factual questions, using a score that rewards correct answers, penalizes mistakes, and allows abstention. Across three training seeds and two held-out confidence thresholds, a learned answer selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the original model’s calibrated confidence filter. On TriviaQA, mean coverage increases from 20.2% to 30.9%, while the pooled error rate among scored answers decreases from 23.0% to 14.5% under exact-match grading. The tested reinforcement-learning changes do not establish consistent gains. On NQ-Open, the selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the filter but still performs worse than always abstaining. A partial human-reviewed audit preserves the TriviaQA finding. Our results support learning to select answers in this setting while showing that reliable abstention across datasets remains unresolved.

[NLP-6] QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM -Generated Quantum Code

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在量子软件测试中的可信度评估问题。现有方法仅衡量大语言模型（LLM）是否生成正确答案，却忽视了其生成的测试用例能否有效区分正确实现与错误实现，而量子程序具有概率性、依赖数值容差且需领域专用检查器评判，导致即使测试语法正确，也可能与基准结果不一致。为此，论文提出 QTestBench 框架，其核心在于通过独立于测试本身的基准检查器（benchmark checker）对 LLM 生成的测试套件进行验证，避免将测试本身视为真实标签。该框架针对每个任务生成语法、语义和行为测试，运行时注入候选解，并在三个不同验证组中对比测试判别结果与检查器标注，以诊断测试质量。实验表明，尽管生成测试几乎均可执行，但其判别能力有限：最佳模型在 QHack 任务上测试质量仅为 0.71，在 Qiskit HumanEval 上仅为 0.34，说明可执行性不能代表测试有效性。通过引入经验证的合成变异体（oracle-verified synthetic mutants），在缺乏自然故障解的情况下（如十项 Qiskit 任务中的三项）仍能稳定估计缺陷检测能力。因此，QTestBench 提供了一个可复现、跨框架的量子测试可信度评估基准。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13811
作者: Meriem Terki,Nouhaila Innan,Minghao Shao,Muhammad Kashif,Alberto Marchisio,Muhammad Shafique
机构: École Supérieure en Informatique de Sidi Bel Abbès (阿尔及利亚西迪贝勒阿布卜斯高等计算机学院); eBRAIN Lab, Division of Engineering, New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) (纽约大学阿布扎比分校工程学院eBRAIN实验室); Center for Quantum and Topological Systems (CQTS), NYUAD Research Institute, NYUAD, Abu Dhabi, UAE (纽约大学阿布扎比分校量子与拓扑系统研究中心); SDU Microelectronics, Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, Odense, Denmark (南丹麦大学机械与电气工程学院微电子研究所)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
备注: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark’s verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker’s label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.

[NLP-7] Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源自动语音识别（ASR）中数据增强方法效果不透明的问题，即现有研究多报告整体错误率的提升，却未阐明不同增强方法在何时、为何有效。其核心解决方案在于通过系统性地交叉对比两种音频层面的增强（速度扰动与SpecAugment）和两种基于文本的增强（修改转录并合成语音），从音素级错误分析出发，揭示了各类方法在错误类型上的互补性。关键发现是：SpecAugment虽能稳定提升整体性能，但会增加声调与软腭化错误；而文本类增强则引入辅音插入错误；二者结合可相互抵消对方引入的错误。这种互补性源于声调与软腭化仅由单一声学特征表征且训练中暴露频率最低，而文本增强通过均衡词频使这些罕见错误的出现频率提升37%–38%，从而逆转其错误模式。组合方法的增益超过单独使用之和，表现出超加性效应，但该效应在训练数据量达到100小时后消失，表明互补性仅存在于低资源场景。因此，论文提出应基于训练暴露程度和声学特征可测性来预先选择适合的增强策略，为低资源场景下的数据增强设计提供可解释、可预测的指导原则。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13807
作者: Katsumi Ibaraki,David Chiang
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 5 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. Tone and palatalization are each signaled by a single acoustic property and occur least frequently in training (lowest training exposure), and text-based methods that flatten word frequency raise their frequency by 37–38%, reversing those errors while further improving aggregate error. The improvement from combining the methods exceeds the sum of their individual improvements; the superadditivity vanishes by 100 hours, limiting the complementarity to the low-resource regime. Where specific error types matter, we recommend selecting augmentation by training exposure and acoustic properties, both measurable before any training.

[NLP-8] REFLECT: Role-Aware Detection of Sentiment Emotion Politeness and Formality

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决对话中语用意义（communicative meaning）检测问题，即如何有效建模情感、情绪、礼貌与正式程度（SEPF）等交际维度的表达机制。现有方法虽依赖上下文语言表示，但未能显式捕捉参与者角色结构对SEPF的塑造作用。其核心解决方案是提出一种角色感知的Transformer架构，将SEPF四个维度映射至基于语言学理论的语义角色标注（SRL）配置，并将其直接嵌入Transformer的自注意力机制中：通过非方向性角色感知注意力建模内在状态（如情感与情绪），利用方向性角色感知注意力捕捉发话人到受话人的外部关系线索（如礼貌与正式程度）。最终，角色感知表征与上下文嵌入通过可学习门控机制融合，实现对角色信息贡献度的自适应加权，而非简单拼接为辅助特征向量。实验表明，该框架在四个基准数据集上显著优于强基线模型（如BERT），尤其在低频复杂情绪及高度礼貌表达等理论预期场景中表现突出；而情感预测提升不显著，暗示情感更多由词汇选择决定，而非角色结构。真实世界心理健康数据上的评估进一步验证了该方法在预测性能与模型可解释性方面的优势，证明了基于语言学原理改进Transformer自注意力机制，能够有效提升对话中语用意义的检测能力，并生成可追溯的角色基础解释。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13797
作者: Sangpil Youm,Annabel Stocks Natalias,Hayden Heninger,Leah Jones,Xiaoyang Jin,Xiaoya Zhang,Bonnie Dorr
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 9 pages, 2 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Detecting communicative meaning in dialogue requires modeling not only lexical content but also the participant-role structures through which sentiment, emotion, politeness, and formality (SEPF) are expressed. Existing approaches rely on contextual language representations while leaving semantic roles implicit. We introduce a role-aware transformer architecture that maps the four SEPF dimensions to theory-grounded Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations, incorporating these configurations directly into the transformer’s self-attention mechanism. Role-aware attention models non-directional internal states (sentiment and emotion), while directional role-aware attention captures initiator-to-recipient relations for external cues (politeness and formality). The resulting role-aware representations are fused with contextual embeddings through a learned gate that adaptively weights how much role information each input contributes, rather than appending semantic roles as an auxiliary feature vector. Across four benchmark datasets, the framework yields statistically reliable gains over strong BERT-based baselines for emotion, politeness, and formality, with gains concentrated in theoretically predicted cases such as low-frequency, complex emotions and highly polite expressions; sentiment improvements are marginal and non-significant, suggesting that sentiment is conveyed more through lexical choice than participant-role structure. Additional evaluation on real-world data demonstrates that the framework improves both predictive performance and model traceability. These results demonstrate that linguistically grounded modifications to transformer self-attention improve the detection of communicative meaning, generalize beyond benchmark datasets to real-world mental-health data, and yield traceable, role-grounded explanations that extend beyond predictive performance to interpretability.

[NLP-9] Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型（Generative AI）对话语标记词（discourse particles）——特别是英语中的“just”与“only”——在自然对话语境中细微语用功能的敏感性问题。这类标记词虽不改变命题的真值条件，却通过反映对话情境和对话者态度来调节话语流，且具有多义性与语义重叠特征，其作用机制长期未被充分研究。论文的关键解决方案在于结合行为实验与机制分析，系统评估大语言模型（LLM）在包含或不含这些标记词的语境下生成内容的偏好与判断差异，并通过指令微调（instruction tuning）增强模型敏感性。研究发现，LLM与人类在使用这些粒子时表现出相似的偏好模式，且对“just”比“only”更敏感；同时，模型生成结果在有无粒子条件下存在显著概率差异，表明其具备对粒子语用功能的内在敏感性。进一步的神经定位分析揭示，“just”与“only”在模型内部的表征存在不对称转移现象：仅“only”相关单元可选择性迁移至“just”的排他性语义，而所有“just”单元均能等效迁移到“only”，暗示模型在词汇层面的粒子表征部分依语义功能组织。该工作为理解大语言模型如何建模语言的微妙语用特性提供了实证支持与机制洞察。

作者: William Sheffield,Jiahui Chen,Amy Zhang,Alex Warstadt,Junyi Jessy Li,Kanishka Misra
机构: The University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校); University of California, San Diego(加州大学圣地亚哥分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English “just” and “only” (“John only/just drinks water”). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to “just” and “only” in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to “just” compared to “only”. Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between “just” and “only” is asymmetric: “only” units transfer selectively to exclusive “just”, while all “just” units transfer to “only” equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at this https URL.

[NLP-10] OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find Whats Missing?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在图像中存在完全遮挡物体时，如何基于剩余视觉线索推断缺失内容的推理能力问题。其核心挑战在于区分直接推理（direct cases）与推断性推理（inferential cases）：前者依赖于具体的物理线索（如阴影、反射），后者则依赖于更广泛的场景上下文。研究通过人工构建的OccludeBench基准测试发现，当前五种VLM在直接案例中的平均准确率为42.7%，而在推断性案例中达62.7%，二者存在20.0个百分点的显著差距，而人类表现则无明显差异（分别为63.4%和68.5%）。为定位失败原因，研究提出OccludeTrace四阶段诊断框架，揭示瓶颈出现在模型从全图投影中恢复相关遮挡对象的阶段——仅在50%的错误案例中成功，而正确案例的成功率高达91%。尽管扩展推理、工具使用及少样本提示等方法带来不一致改进，但无法稳定缩小差距。相比之下，“先修复再验证”（inpaint-then-confront）干预策略，即先生成候选遮挡物体，再将其与可见物理线索进行比对，显著降低了差距至统计上不显著水平，尤其在具备图像生成能力的模型中效果突出。该研究的关键贡献在于建立了一个可控且可操作的诊断范式，系统揭示了VLM在处理视觉缺失信息时的推理局限，并提出了有效的干预路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13790
作者: Jasin Cekinmez,Addison J. Wu,Ryo Mitsuhashi,Linrong Cai,Xingyu Fu,Zhuang Liu
机构: Princeton University (普林斯顿大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.

[NLP-11] UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在乌克兰战争背景下，如何有效识别和分析网络迷因（meme）中所使用的说服性技巧（persuasion techniques）这一关键问题。由于迷因在政治冲突中的传播中融合了视觉与文本线索，传统方法难以全面捕捉其多模态说服机制，因此亟需一种能够理解图像与语言协同作用的分析框架。论文提出的核心解决方案是构建并应用基于多模态大模型（vision-language models, VLMs）的零样本提示（zero-shot prompting）检测方法，并引入两个关键数据集：UkrMeme，一个包含200个真实生成的乌克兰战时迷因且标注了说服性技巧的数据集；以及PTM-UA，即对Propaganda 950基准中部分条目进行乌克兰语翻译并保留原始视觉内容的版本，以确保跨语言可比性。通过采用分层F1指标评估多模态输入下的性能，并对比层间相关性传播（Layer-wise Relevance Propagation, LRP）与模型自动生成的词元归因（token attributions）两种解释方法，研究进一步揭示了不同解释技术所强调的语义证据类别差异，从而为理解VLM在迷因说服性分析中的可解释性提供了实证基础。

作者: Nazar Andrushko,Vera Schmitt,Veronika Solopova

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.

[NLP-12] A Privileged Teacher That Only Scores Cannot Search: Critique-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于可验证奖励的强化学习（verifiable-reward RL）中稀疏奖励信号导致的训练效率低下问题，特别是如何在生成式推理过程中实现细粒度的信用分配。传统自蒸馏方法通过一个以参考解为条件的教师模型对学生的推理轨迹进行评分，试图将稀疏的最终结果奖励转化为密集的词元级信用信号，但其核心问题是：该评分信号无法有效定位错误、也无法促使模型降低错误词元的概率。研究发现，现有自蒸馏目标所依赖的全分布KL散度和词元对数似然比均不具备错误局部化能力，且无法可靠区分同一问题中正确与错误的推理路径。作者指出，这一失败具有结构性根源——识别推理轨迹中的错误本质上是一个搜索问题，而评分型教师并未被显式赋予执行此搜索的任务。相比之下，当允许模型先生成对当前推理的批判性评价（critique），再以该批判为条件构建评分教师时，新提出的“批判条件化自蒸馏”（critique-conditioned self-distillation）能够显著提升错误定位能力，产生具有纠正性的信号，并引导模型概率向诸如“Wait”、“But”、“Actually”等提示回溯的词元转移。实验进一步表明，该批判信号在测试阶段可使模型从错误推理中恢复，从而求解原本无法通过采样解决的数学问题；在冷启动的广义策略优化（GRPO）中，亦能在缺乏可验证奖励的提示上提供有效的优势信号。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13744
作者: Mayug Maniparambil,Ayush Rai,Ekansh Verma,Noel E. O’Connor,Fergal Reid
机构: Fin.ai(金融人工智能); Dublin City University(都柏林城市大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted as an oral at the FLLMPT workshop, NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:On-policy self-distillation promises to replace the sparse outcome signal of verifiable-reward RL with dense token-level credit: a teacher conditioned on the reference solution scores the student’s own rollout, and the resulting distributional shift is distilled back into the policy. We investigate whether this scoring signal actually contains corrective credit. Using gold error spans in student rollouts, we test the two signals consumed by self-distillation objectives, the full-distribution KL and the token log-ratio, for two properties: whether they localize errors and whether they push probability away from erroneous student tokens. They exhibit neither of these properties nor can they reliably distinguish correct from incorrect rollouts within the same problem. We argue that this failure is structural: locating an error in a reasoning trace is itself a search problem, while a scoring teacher is never explicitly asked to perform that search. The same model, with the same privileged information, localizes errors substantially better when allowed to generate a critique. This forms the motivation for \emphcritique-conditioned self-distillation: first generate a critique of the current rollout, then condition the scoring teacher on that critique. The resulting signal localizes errors, is corrective within error spans, and shifts probability toward tokens that initiate backtracking such as Wait'', But’‘, and ``Actually’'. We further show that the critique is useful both at test time, where resuming a wrong rollout with the critique in context converts math problems the model cannot solve by sampling, and in cold-start GRPO, where it provides an advantage signal on prompts for which verifiable rewards alone provide none.

[NLP-13] Enhancing Legal Reasoning in Pre-trained Language Models via Knowledge Graph-Guided Multi-Task Pre-training EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决法律语言理解中对半结构化法规文本进行推理的能力不足问题，现有法律语言模型依赖于掩码语言建模（Masked Language Modeling, MLM）等标准预训练目标，将法规文本视为扁平的词元序列，忽视了其内在的层级结构约束。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种多任务预训练方法，专门针对德语交通法规（StVO）设计，通过结合三种互补的目标：下一句预测（Next Sentence Prediction, NSP）、基于知识图谱（Knowledge Graph, KG）引导的聚类（CLU）以及基于知识图谱感知的段落分类（CLS），显式地将结构化法律知识编码至模型权重之中。这一机制使模型在推理阶段具备零样本法律推理能力，无需依赖离散的知识图谱遍历。实验结果表明，该方法在九种Transformer编码器上共324次运行中均表现出显著性能提升，在合成StVO问答任务中相对基线提升达10.3%至155.0%，并在七个法律基准中的四个上超越了已有的LexGLUE基准，同时在奥地利驾驶法规上实现了3.4%至15.8%的一致零样本迁移增益，验证了该训练方法在跨领域场景下的良好泛化能力。

作者: Ibrahim Siddig,Munir Georges
机构: AImotion Bavaria, Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt(艾莫动巴伐利亚，英戈尔施塔特应用技术大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at the NLLP 2026 Workshop, co-located with EMNLP 2026. 9 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. We evaluate our approach across nine Transformer-based encoders and 324 experimental runs. On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.

[NLP-14] Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长上下文推理场景中因KV缓存（Key-Value Cache）内存不足导致硬件利用率受限的问题，尤其针对现有方法在支持推测解码（speculative decoding）时的局限性。其核心挑战在于如何在有限的GPU显存下高效管理历史键值对，同时兼容如DSpark和DFlash2等基于草稿模型的推测解码机制，并在高并发与超长上下文（如100K、500K tokens）条件下维持高性能与低延迟。解决方案的关键是提出Adaptive DHiSparse，一种支持分层稀疏KV结构的自适应存储架构：它通过动态调整数据驻留策略，在保证必要工作集（working set）的前提下，利用空闲显存保留更多历史信息；当内存压力增大时，可选择性地将部分数据移至主机内存，并通过精确融合检索（exact fused retrieval）恢复缺失内容。该方案继承了DSpark与DFlash2的提案与验证规则，包括共享缺失行检索、环形窗口绑定草稿KV以及跨层组复用验证阶段，从而在100K上下文、并发128时实现每解码GPU 793输出词元/秒，较HiSparse提升1.45倍，较非推测性自适应服务提升1.27倍；在相同延迟约束下，支持高达4倍的并发量及2.3至3.7倍的输出吞吐。在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上，500K上下文、并发512时，其输出为驻留式服务的1.85倍。负载较低时，可选驻留策略将主机访问比例从14.2%降至1.4%，有效缓解内存压力并优化资源利用。

作者: Naji Alazhar,Wassel Alazhar
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 16 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45 \times HiSparse and 1.27 \times non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4 \times the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7 \times the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85 \times the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.

[NLP-15] Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph ISWC2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在可靠性关键领域（如法律）中因模型黑箱特性导致的可解释性与可验证性不足的问题。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统难以满足透明性和可追溯性要求，而检索增强生成（Retrieval Augmented Generation, RAG）虽通过引入可解释文档以降低“幻觉”风险，但在面对大量且复杂的源文档时，传统检索方法易忽略关键上下文信息，导致引用准确性下降。为此，本文聚焦德国民法典场景，提出一种基于结构驱动解析构建知识图谱（Knowledge Graph, KG）的方法，用于支持源文档的导航与精准检索；并通过对比多种由知识图谱指导的文本分块与检索策略，评估其对引用准确性的影响，其核心解决方案在于利用结构化知识图谱提升检索相关性与上下文感知能力，从而实现更准确、可验证的法律文本生成。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13695
作者: Ibrahim Siddig,Sviatoslav Tugeev,Munir Georges
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at the RAGE-KG 2026 Workshop, co-located with ISWC 2026. 7 pages, 3 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI ‘hallucinations’ and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. In this paper we aim to tackle this problem in the context of German Legal Code. Using structure-driven parsing to create a Knowledge Graph (KG) for the source document navigation and retrieval, we compare several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies and evaluate their effect on the accuracy of retrieved citations.

[NLP-16] Retractions Revisited: A Replication Extension and Mechanistic Evaluation of Linguistic Obfuscation Effects in Fraudulent Science

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在开放科学时代背景下，学术造假行为与语言模糊性（linguistic obfuscation）之间关系的实证验证不足问题，尤其关注语言模糊性是否为欺诈性科研论文的核心特征，以及其背后的心理机制。研究通过对比2013至2025年间800篇伪造论文与800篇真实对照论文，发现伪造论文确实表现出更高的语言模糊性，支持了语言模糊性假说。其解决方案的关键在于构建并检验一个平行中介模型，识别出“现实监控能力”（reality monitoring）下降——表现为形容词使用频率降低——是连接学术欺诈与语言模糊性的最有力心理机制。此外，基于语言模糊性特征的分类器（准确率60.7%）及包含百余个语言维度的弹性网络模型（准确率71.6%）均显著优于随机猜测水平，表明语言特征可作为识别学术不端的有效工具，对科学诚信维护与语言心理机制研究具有重要启示。
