点击查看摘要

Abstract:Technologies like large language models make it easier to convert cultural material into analyzable variables, while LLM-driven agentic systems extend machine assistance to other parts of the research workflow. Rather than a full how-to guide or an exhaustive review of recent LLM use cases, this chapter looks at some crucial aspects of this new paradigm as well as the bigger picture. I argue that these technologies expand the scale, methodological range, and scope for delegation, while the basic logic by which those measurements support cultural claims remains mostly unchanged.

[NLP-86] REDaCT: Collapse-Free Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models EMNLP2026 ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大推理模型（Large Reasoning Models, LRMs）在去遗忘（unlearning）过程中，如何在不引发推理崩溃（reasoning collapse）的前提下，有效移除与遗忘集（forget-set）相关的信息问题。现有方法虽能实现答案和推理链中的遗忘信息删除，但常导致模型无法生成连贯的思维链（chain-of-thought, CoT）或无法正确终止推理过程。本文提出一种基于推理时的去遗忘框架REDaCT（REgenerate via Detection and Corrective Tuning），其核心创新在于：（1）设计一个二分类泄漏检测器，在推理过程中识别出包含遗忘集信息的推理句子；（2）引入离线训练的嵌入优化模块，学习一组修正嵌入（corrective embedding），在首次检测到泄漏时注入模型初始状态，引导后续推理路径避开泄露内容。该方案的关键在于通过检测-修正机制实现对推理过程的精准干预，从而在保证完美答案遗忘和近乎完全的推理链遗忘的同时，显著提升推理连贯性，彻底避免推理崩溃现象。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12769
作者: Joshua Maccoby,Wendy Hui Wang
机构: Stevens Institute of Technology(史蒂文斯理工学院); Hoboken, New Jersey, USA(新泽西州霍博肯市，美国)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Copyright 2026 Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL). Licensed under CC BY 4.0

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Unlearning in large reasoning models (LRMs) requires removing forget-set information from both the reasoning trace and the final answer. Existing approaches achieve this objective at the cost of reasoning collapse, where the model fails to produce a coherent chain-of-thought (CoT) and does not properly terminate its reasoning process. To address this challenge, we propose REDaCT (REgenerate via Detection and Corrective Tuning), an inference-time unlearning framework for LRMs. REDaCT consists of two key components: (1) a binary leak detector that identifies sentences in the reasoning trace that leak forget-set information, and (2) an embedding optimization module that learns a corrective embedding offline, such that when injected at the first detected leak during inference, it guides subsequent reasoning towards sentences that do not leak forget-set information. Experimental results show that REDaCT completely avoids reasoning collapse, substantially improving reasoning preservation compared to state-of-the-art unlearning methods while maintaining perfect answer forgetting and near-perfect CoT forgetting. Our code is available at: this https URL.

[NLP-87] DistressBench: Evaluating Multi-Dimensional Crisis Support in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型在应对用户自伤与自杀（SSH）危机情境时，评估体系滞后于实际应用需求的问题。随着模型使用场景日益偏向情感性而非信息性交互，用户在对话中频繁暴露心理危机，而现有安全评估基准主要依赖模型“拒绝回应”这一被动行为作为衡量标准，无法反映其在危机干预中应提供的实质性支持。本文提出关键解决方案——构建DistressBench，一个包含718条由临床专家撰写的真实用户发言的英文对话数据集，覆盖23类SSH子类别，每条对话均配有任务特定评分细则（基于七维危机支持框架的加权原子标准）及临床参考回复。模型得分以满足加权标准的比例计算，直接体现其交付关怀服务的完整性。结果显示，表现最优的前沿模型仅达成88.4%的加权标准，中位模型为71.4%，远低于临床参考的98.7%；更严重的是，在35.3%的案例中，尽管模型能识别危机，却未能引导用户寻求人类帮助，该短板集中体现在需主动行动而非沉默回避的维度。通过对比各维度最佳模型与中位模型的表现差异，揭示出能力瓶颈与策略选择的分野：如情绪安抚维度最佳模型达74.6%而中位仅为46.0%，安全免责声明则从84.6%降至8.3%。多轮对话整体表现低于单轮（68.5% vs 74.2%）。研究主张应将危机安全评估重心从“拒绝内容”转向“提供照护的质量”，并明确将情绪安抚与资源转介纳入模型部署的核心要求。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12758
作者: Drew Rein,Patrick Oathout,Vishal Kumar,Udari Madhushani Sehwag
机构: Scale AI
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: 39 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models have been adopted faster than evaluation practices that reliably assess their risks, and a growing share of use is affective rather than informational. Within that traffic users disclose suicide and self-harm (SSH) crises. Existing safety benchmarks score models primarily on refusal, but refusal is not the desired behavior here; the conversation requires a substantive supportive response. We introduce DistressBench, 718 English conversations with clinician-authored user turns spanning 23 SSH subcategories, each paired with a task-specific rubric of weighted atomic criteria across seven dimensions of crisis support and a clinician reference response. A model’s score is the weighted average over the criteria its reply satisfies, reading directly as the fraction of required care delivered. The best of 25 frontier models satisfies 88.4% of weighted criteria and the median model 71.4%, against 98.7% for clinician references scored on the same criteria. Pooled across all 25 models, in 35.3% of conversations where a model satisfied every criterion for recognizing the crisis, it failed to route the user toward human help. The shortfall concentrates in the dimensions requiring the model to act rather than withhold. Contrasting each dimension’s median model against its best separates capability limits from choices: de-escalation reaches 74.6% in the strongest model against a median of 46.0%, and safety disclaimers 84.6% against 8.3%. Multi-turn conversations score below single-turn ones (68.5% against 74.2%). We release the corpus, rubrics, judge calibration labels, and a companion annex of 20 long-horizon red-team transcripts. These results argue for evaluating crisis safety on the care a model delivers rather than on what it declines to say, and for treating de-escalation and resource routing as deployment requirements.

[NLP-88] MADS: Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation for Robust Conversational Agents INTERSPEECH

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决任务导向型对话代理（task-oriented conversational agents）在真实场景下因用户非合作行为导致的脆弱性问题。现有函数调用基准数据集对对抗性对话轨迹的覆盖不足，限制了鲁棒对话代理的训练资源。为此，本文提出MADS（Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation）——一种合成数据生成管道，能够生成结构化且多样化的对话轨迹，并通过引入对抗性对话，构建出反映真实不愉快对话路径的验证对话序列。基于MADS，研究构建了MADS-Bench基准，涵盖六个领域、55种人格设定和1095条对话，其中约66%的对话包含易失败的场景。解决方案的关键在于采用两阶段训练框架：首先进行监督微调（SFT），再结合可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），从而有效提升模型在复杂、非合作情境下的鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12757
作者: Arkajyoti Chakraborty,Adam Zernik,Ishika Kulkarni,Mudit Arora,Hugo Lin,Justin Chiu,Alessandro Di Bari,Neha Gupta,Andreas Stolcke
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Submitted to Interspeech in February 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under realistic conditions, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present MADS (Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation), a synthetic data generation pipeline that produces structured, diverse dialogue trajectories. We inject adversarial conversation, producing validated conversation trajectories that capture realistic, unhappy paths. Using MADS, we construct MADS-Bench: a benchmark spanning six domains, 55 personas, and 1095 conversations, with approximately 66% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We evaluate the robustness of the trained models using a two-stage training approach that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).

[NLP-89] U4RASD at KnowledgeGraphEval-2026: Ontology-Constrained Encoder and LLM Systems for Arabic Relation Extraction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决阿拉伯语中定向关系抽取（Directed Arabic Relation Extraction）问题，即从给定的阿拉伯语句子及实体对中预测40种预定义关系之一或“无关系”（no_relation）。其核心挑战在于阿拉伯语语言特性带来的复杂性，如丰富的形态变化和上下文依赖。解决方案的关键在于结合多种建模策略：一方面采用基于编码器的系统，通过引入类型化实体标记（typed entity markers）并分离关系存在性判断与关系分类任务，提升模型对细粒度关系的识别能力；另一方面利用大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）方法，对Yehia和Qwen3.5模型进行QLoRA微调，并引入本体约束（ontology-constrained prediction）以增强预测的语义合理性。最终，通过融合Yehia-RE、Qwen-RE与TypedPair三个系统的集成模型，在子任务2中取得了94.06的micro-F1得分，排名第一，验证了约束性预测与互补建模策略在阿拉伯语关系抽取中的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12742
作者: Ahmad Abbas,Hussein Mazeh,Chadi Abou Chakra,Aya Jouni,Mohammad Ballout,Fadi A. Zaraket
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 20 pages. System description paper for the KnowledgeGraphEval 2026 Shared Task at ArabicNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper details our submission to KnowledgeGraphEval 2026 Subtask 2 on directed Arabic relation extraction. We explored encoder-based and large language model approaches for predicting one of 40 relations or no_relation from an Arabic sentence and a subject-object pair. Our encoder systems use typed entity markers and separate relation-existence and relation-classification heads, while our LLM systems fine-tune Yehia and Qwen3.5 with QLoRA and ontology-constrained prediction. Our best system, an ensemble of Yehia-RE, Qwen-RE, and TypedPair, achieved a micro-F1 score of 94.06 and ranked 1st in Subtask 2. Yehia-RE (full-vocabulary) achieved 92.98, while the best encoder and Qwen-RE achieved 92.69 and 91.94 respectively. Our results highlight the importance of constrained prediction and complementary modeling approaches for Arabic relation extraction.

[NLP-90] Unsupervised Multimodal Reward Modeling

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态生成任务中高质量视觉-语言奖励模型（Vision-Language Reward Models, VL-RMs）训练依赖昂贵、易产生分歧且难以统一的真人偏好标注数据的问题。传统方法通常基于人工标注的偏好对（preference pairs）进行训练，但此类数据收集成本高、一致性差，且模型性能评估高度依赖于特定基准测试的排名，存在偏差风险。为此，本文提出一种无需任何人工偏好标签的新型解决方案：在冻结的Qwen3-VL主干网络的中间层上添加一个线性头，通过对比同一图像的原始文本描述与其扰动版本的得分来训练该线性头，仅利用少量标注数据用于选择最优中间层。其核心创新在于“无监督扰动驱动”的训练范式——利用同一图像的文本扰动作为伪偏好信号，使目标函数具有凸性，从而避免了复杂微调过程。实验表明，该方法在仅需数千参数和千分之一微调计算量的情况下，便可在多个基准上达到或超越GPT-4o的表现，尤其在VL-RewardBench上领先6.6分；当与人工标注的RLAIF-V对相比，在相同样本预算下，扰动机制可提升3至5分。此外，通过将模型自身生成的候选样本交由验证器（verifier）标注后重新训练头部，能有效降低文本幻觉（减少5.1 CHAIR点），并提升图像生成通过率（提高5.4点），尽管在标准奖励基准上得分略降。综上，该方案的关键突破在于：以中间层探针（intermediate-layer probe）、同图扰动数据生成机制及验证器引导的自举流程（verifier-driven bootstrap）构成一套完全无需人工标注、计算成本极低且由训练目标本身定义的多模态奖励建模新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12707
作者: Yueying Li,Jingxuan Fan,Kianté Brantley,Sham M. Kakade,Hanlin Zhang
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (麻省理工学院); Cornell University (康奈尔大学); Scale AI; Harvard University (哈佛大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-language reward models are trained on annotated preference pairs, which are expensive to collect, can disagree, and are ranked by benchmark accuracy. We build one with no human preference label: a linear head on an intermediate layer of a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone, trained to score a web caption above a perturbed version of the same caption; labeled data enters only to select the layer. The layer is the decisive choice, worth 5.8 points over the last layer, and one recipe transferred without re-tuning beats or at least matches GPT-4o on three benchmarks at 32B, 6.6 points ahead on VL-RewardBench, from a few thousand parameters at about a thousandth of fine-tuning compute. At an equal pair budget, perturbations teach a frozen head 3 to 5 points more than curated RLAIF-V pairs. Because the backbone is frozen, the objective is convex, and the perturbation sampler specifies the reward, which the benchmark does not identify: two heads trained on disjoint halves of the same perturbations tie on the benchmark and differ by 6.4 points in hallucination judging. Retraining the head on the policy’s own verifier-labeled candidates cuts caption hallucination by 5.1 CHAIR points and lifts image-generation pass rate by 5.4, while scoring lower on every reward benchmark. Together, an intermediate-layer probe, free same-image perturbations, and a verifier-driven bootstrap turn give a recipe for multimodal reward modeling that needs no annotator, costs a fraction of fine-tuning, and is specified by the comparisons it is trained on rather than by a benchmark rank. [NLP-91] GeoFitBench-LLM : A Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models Capabilities in Geospatial Data Requirements Elicitation for Geo-Analytic Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在地理人工智能（GeoAI）系统中应用时，缺乏对地理空间数据需求提取能力评估的问题。现有评估体系普遍忽视了从自然语言查询中准确识别地理分析任务所需的数据集、支持资源及约束条件的关键环节，而这一环节直接影响检索导向型地理分析任务的可靠性。为此，本文提出GeoFitBench-LLM基准测试框架，用于评估LLMs在自然语言地理分析请求下推断必要数据集、支撑资源与使用约束的能力。其核心创新在于构建了两个推理维度——时空关系（Spatio-Temporal Relational）与语义锚定（Semantic Grounding），以反映地理信息检索与自然语言理解中的长期挑战。通过采用固定且供应商无关的结构化真值标注模式，实现了资源识别与属性级规范的可复现评估。实验结果表明，在最小提示条件下，尽管多数模型能够部分识别必要资源（如GPT-5.4 Thinking在66.67%的请求中完整恢复全部资源），但随着推理复杂度提升，满足“适用性”（fitness-for-use）的精确规范仍面临显著困难，凸显了当前模型在深层语义理解与约束推理方面的局限性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12669
作者: Amirhossein Vahdat,Thierry Badard,Luc Lamontagne
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Presented as an Oral Presentation Paper at GeoAI 2026, Ghent, Belgium. Also available on Zenodo

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models are becoming central to GeoAI systems, yet their evaluation rarely considers the elicitation of geospatial data requirements. This omission is critical as retrieval oriented geo-analytic tasks cannot be supported reliably without first identifying the necessary datasets and constraints. GeoFitBench-LLM is introduced as a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs can infer the datasets, the supporting resources and the constraints required by geo-analytic requests in natural language. The benchmark is structured around two reasoning dimensions, Spatio-Temporal Relational and Semantic Grounding, reflecting long-standing challenges in geospatial information retrieval and related natural language tasks. Ground truth requirements are encoded in a fixed, provider-independent schema for reproducible evaluation of resource identification and attribute-level specification. Experiments on seven models under minimal prompting indicate that identifying the necessary resources is often achievable, with GPT-5.4 Thinking achieving the best result by recovering the complete set of resources in 66.67% of benchmark requests. Results further indicate that accurate fitness-for-use specification remains more difficult as inferential demands increase.

[NLP-92] Recurrent Harness for Agent ic Continual Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型代理（language model agent）在长期交互流中面临的数据分布漂移（distribution shift）问题，其核心挑战在于如何在不依赖离线回放数据或额外验证数据的前提下，实现在线持续学习（continual learning）中的有效状态适应。现有方法通常仅通过前向信息流更新代理状态，或依赖外部记忆库与验证集进行优化，难以在严格在线流式协议下保持性能。针对这一问题，论文提出ReHarness——一种基于循环结构的代理持续学习框架，其关键创新在于引入“反向修正”（backward revision）机制：在每个输入实例处理后，利用生成的轨迹作为反馈，对先前检索到的反思内容（reflections）进行动态修正，并将该反馈沿文本代理状态向后传播。这一机制使代理能够基于当前任务的上下文，主动调整过往经验的表征，从而提升对分布偏移的适应能力。实验表明，ReHarness在三个持续学习基准与三种语言模型主干上均显著优于原始上下文基线、基于记忆与反思的方法以及提示优化技术；进一步分析揭示，该方法能生成具有源始依据且语义连贯的修正内容，有效纠正过拟合或过时的经验，同时兼顾学习过程中的稳定性与可塑性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12668
作者: Yuxin Xiao,Zhiyun Lu,Jianyu Wang,Yangtian Zhang,Yang Song,Qifan Wang,Bailin Wang
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (麻省理工学院); Meta MRS Research; Yale University (耶鲁大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language model agents increasingly operate over long interaction streams, requiring online adaptation to distribution shifts through continual learning. However, existing agent harnesses typically either evolve their states only through forward information flow or rely on additional replay or validation data for harness optimization. To address this, we propose ReHarness, a recurrent harness framework for agentic continual learning that complements forward read and write with backward revision under a strictly online streaming protocol. We ask what information could have been captured differently in the harness state to better inform the current instance in the stream. Specifically, after each instance, we leverage the resulting trajectory as feedback to revise the reflections retrieved for that instance, thereby propagating feedback backward through the textual harness state. Across three continual learning benchmarks and three language model backbones, ReHarness consistently outperforms strong raw-context baselines, memory- and reflection-based methods, and prompt optimization approaches. Further analysis shows that ReHarness produces source-grounded and meaningful revisions, corrects overgeneralized or outdated experience under distribution shifts, and improves both stability and plasticity during continual learning.

[NLP-93] perturber: A Stateless Service for Semantics-Preserving Text Perturbations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在干净基准测试中过度高估模型鲁棒性的问题。真实输入通常存在语义保持性的扰动，而这些微小变化常导致模型输出发生显著偏离，但现有评估工具将扰动方法与基准测试框架耦合，缺乏可复现性和模块化设计。为此，本文提出“perturber”——一个无状态的服务与Python库，其核心创新在于每次调用仅施加一种语义保持性扰动，并从包含68种扰动、覆盖11类家族的自有目录中选取，通过单一基础原语实现，组合逻辑由调用方自行链式构建，确保服务与库在构造上输出一致。该方案的关键在于将扰动操作解耦为可复用的转换层，支持逐个、可重现且跨环境一致地应用扰动，同时对工具本身进行严格评估，包括正确性、可复现性与成本，并量化每种扰动的语义保持程度，而非假设其成立。研究还提供交互式演示平台、可审视的扰动目录及一键复现评估流程，显著提升了评测的透明度与可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12667
作者: Khoi-Nguyen Tran
机构: IBM Research(IBM研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 14 pages (6 main + references and appendix), 5 figures, 13 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) evaluations on clean benchmarks overstate model robustness: real inputs arrive perturbed, and these meaning-preserving variants routinely move model answers. Studying this systematically requires applying perturbations one at a time, reproducibly, and identically wherever they run, yet existing tools couple them to a benchmarking stack rather than packaging them as a reusable transform layer. We present perturber, a stateless service and Python library that applies exactly one semantics-preserving perturbation per call, drawn from a first-party catalog of 68 perturbations across 11 families. It turns on a single primitive, with composition left to the caller chaining calls, so the service and the library produce identical output by construction. We evaluate the tool itself, its correctness, reproducibility, and cost, rather than any model’s robustness, measuring meaning-preservation per perturbation rather than assuming it. The demonstration adds a live playground, an introspectable catalog for benchmark selection, and a one-command reproducible evaluation.

[NLP-94] Cancerous Backdoor Attack: Gradual Activation via Invisible Tokens and A Stage Controller

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）后门攻击中普遍存在的“单点激活”局限性问题，即攻击行为通常在触发条件满足时立即显现，缺乏对渐进式恶意行为演化的探索。其核心解决方案是提出一种名为“癌变式后门攻击”（Cancerous Backdoor Attack）的新方法，该方法通过引入不可见标记（invisible tokens）和阶段控制器（stage controller），实现对模型推理过程的渐进式污染。其中，不可见标记在用户可见输入中不显式出现，但隐式引导模型进入多个中间攻击阶段；阶段控制器则在推理过程中动态追踪攻击进展，确保恶意行为按预设阶段逐步演化，最终才触发终端异常行为。实验表明，该攻击在多个推理数据集上均能稳定引发渐进式的推理偏差，且显著优于已有基线攻击方法。研究结果揭示，后门攻击导致的推理腐败可能在可见输出前已悄然积累，因此仅依赖回答准确性进行检测已不足以有效识别此类攻击，凸显了对渐进式威胁检测机制的需求。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12644
作者: Tahmid Imtiaz Imu,Emama Nahid,Prodipta Sen Amartya,Ahsanul Jobayer,Yutong Song,Jiang Wu,Pengfei Zhang,Honghui Xu
机构: Kennesaw State University (肯尼索州立大学); University of Dhaka (达卡大学); University of California, Irvine (加州大学欧文分校); Independent Researcher (独立研究员)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 31 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Backdoor Attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) typically follow a trigger-response pattern, where satisfying a trigger condition activates a single terminal behavior. However, this single-point backdoor activation does not explore attacks in which malicious behavior develops gradually through multiple intermediate stages before reaching the terminal activation stage. We present Cancerous Backdoor Attack, that gradually corrupts an LLM’s reasoning over a sequence of interactions by leveraging invisible tokens and a stage controller. Specifically, invisible tokens provide hidden stages to the model without appearing in the user’s visible request and the stage controller tracks the attack’s progression during inference to realize gradual activation. We evaluate Cancerous Backdoor Attack across several reasoning datasets. The attack consistently produces gradual reasoning corruption across models and tasks. We compare Cancerous Backdoor Attack with prior backdoor attack baselines to demonstrate our proposed attack outperforms the baselines. Our results indicate that reasoning corruption can develop gradually before it becomes visible, making answer accuracy alone insufficient for detecting backdoor attacks.

[NLP-95] Knowing Is Not Telling: Identity Ossification in LLM Representations of Trans-border Communities

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多民族跨境身份在生成式AI（Generative AI）中被简化为单一国家认同的“身份固化”（identity ossification）问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管许多族群如萨米人、罗兴亚人及库尔德人长期跨越政治边界存在，具有共享的历史、语言与文化，但当前大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理此类跨边境民族身份时，往往将其错误地归约为某一特定主权国家的固定身份，从而忽视了其流动性与跨国性特征。该研究提出跨边境身份固化诊断框架（Transborder Identity Ossification Diagnostic Framework, TIODF），通过对比直接事实性提问与开放式叙事性提问的回答差异，区分固化现象是源于知识缺失还是模型固有的叙述框架偏差。实验表明，不同模型及语言版本间固化现象差异显著——例如，GPT-5.1在英文回答中仅10.1%出现固化，而DeepSeek-V3.2在中文回答中高达62.6%。即使模型能正确回答事实问题，仍可能在叙事中呈现单一国家叙事，揭示出固化本质上是模型叙述范式的问题，而非单纯信息不足。这一发现对评估多语言人工智能系统中的文化公平性具有重要意义。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12610
作者: Minglu Sun,Lan Chen,Hang Jiang
机构: Northeastern University (东北大学); The University of Texas at Austin (德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校)
类目: Computers and Society (cs.CY); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Ethnic and cultural identities rarely align with political borders, a tension made sharper by migration and long-standing cross-border ties. Communities such as the Sami, the Rohingya, and the Kurds have long lived across more than one state. This tension is especially clear in mainland Southeast Asia, where many communities share history, language, and culture across state lines. We study nine such transborder ethnic communities along China’s southwestern border with mainland Southeast Asia, looking at how large language models (LLMs) represent them. We define and study identity ossification: a pattern where LLMs turn a fluid, cross-border ethnic identity into a single, fixed nation-state identity. We introduce the Transborder Identity Ossification Diagnostic Framework (TIODF) that compares direct factual questions with open-ended narrative questions to test whether ossification comes from missing knowledge or from how models frame their answers. We test GPT-5.1 and DeepSeek-V3.2 in English and Chinese. Ossification varies substantially across models and query languages. It appears in only 10.1% of GPT-5.1’s English answers, but in 62.6% of DeepSeek-V3.2’s Chinese answers. Models often still tell a single-nation story even when they answer the factual question correctly. This decoupling suggests that ossification reflects narrative framing rather than simple knowledge absence, which matters for how we test cultural fairness in multilingual AI systems.

[NLP-96] Self-Preservation in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决持续学习（Continual Learning, CL）中模型在增量学习过程中对已有知识的遗忘问题，尤其关注当前任务保留机制仅覆盖部分先验知识而无法有效防止跨任务遗忘的局限性。其核心挑战在于如何在缺乏原始训练数据的前提下，实现对模型更广泛能力的自我保护。解决方案的关键在于引入“任务银行（Task Bank）”机制，通过组织任务描述及其示例，构建可组合的结构化知识库，并利用冻结的Qwen系列大模型生成补充性重放（replay）数据。研究发现，生成式重放能够显著减少任务银行外任务的遗忘现象；结合多个部分任务银行可进一步提升整体保留性能；更重要的是，在固定样本预算下，模型具备自主选择重放目标的能力——基于新任务信息指导的选择策略可在4B规模模型上提升未见任务的保留率，优于随机选择，表明模型能以自适应方式优化自身知识保护。这揭示了生成式AI在实现自我调节式持续学习中的潜力，为构建更具鲁棒性的自适应系统提供了新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12602
作者: Dongkyu Cho,Rumi Chunara,Ali Behrouz
机构: New York University (纽约大学); Google(谷歌)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 25 pages, 12 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Continual learning (CL) seeks to adapt pretrained models while preserving prior capabilities. Yet the tasks supplied for preservation cover only part of what a model knows, while forgetting can extend beyond them. Recent work shows that language models can supplement this limited evidence by generating useful replay without access to their original training data. This raises a question about self-preservation: can a model help choose preservation targets that protect its own capabilities more broadly? To study this question, we organize task descriptions and their examples into Task Banks, whose entries can be selected and combined to guide replay generation by a frozen model. Continual instruction tuning with Qwen models of varying sizes yields three findings. First, the new task and learning rate shape which prior capabilities degrade, while tracking previously correct answers reveals losses that average accuracy can conceal. Second, generated replay reduces forgetting on tasks outside the bank. Combining partial banks strengthens this protection, improving mean retention of previously correct answers over either bank alone across the tested sizes. Third, the model can also help choose replay targets: selection informed by the new task improves mean held-out retention over random selection at 4B, with similar new-task gains, although smaller models show no corresponding advantage. Under a fixed example budget, however, replacing new-task examples with replay improves preservation at the cost of smaller new-task gains. Together, these findings show that models can support broader self-preservation by generating replay data and, in some settings, choosing which tasks to replay.

[NLP-97] Reflective Prompt Optimization of a Deep-Research Agent : A Topic-Disjoint Multi-Seed Protocol for Measuring Transferable Gains and Prompt-Level Overfitting

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型代理在事实类任务中进行提示优化（prompt optimization）时存在的“记忆化”失败模式，即优化器可能通过将训练样本的答案直接写入提示，导致性能提升源于对训练数据的过拟合而非可迁移的行为。传统基于标量奖励的强化学习不会出现此类问题，而提示优化因成本低且输出可读，成为替代方案，但其潜在缺陷需被识别与规避。本文提出的关键解决方案是采用反思式提示演化（Reflective Prompt Evolution, GEPA），并在多智能体深度研究系统中对两个系统级提示进行优化。为确保评估可信性，实验设计采用主题不重叠划分（topic-disjoint split），即训练、验证与测试集无共享主题，从而有效隔离记忆效应。结果表明，未见提示的验证集表现优于保留测试集表现（验证-保留差距显著），但控制消融实验显示，即使提示中包含大量训练答案的直接复制内容，这些内容在对应训练问题上也未能获得奖励，说明性能增益并非来自记忆，而是由小样本选择偏差与噪声评判共同导致。进一步分析发现，按维度分解的反馈信息（decomposed per-dimension feedback） 是实现泛化性能提升的关键因果因素；若将其压缩为单一标量奖励，则保留测试集表现反而下降。此外，该性能增益在跨家族评判者（out-of-family judge）下仍能保持，并可通过人工编写的优化策略复现，证明其具备可解释性和可迁移性。因此，论文强调：可信的提示优化评估必须包含保留主题、多随机种子以及评判器敏感性分析等要素。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12601
作者: Elias Lumer,Sahil Sen,Vamse Kumar Subbiah,Kevin Paul
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Prompt optimization is an attractive alternative to reinforcement learning for adapting language-model agents, since it is cheap and produces human-readable artifacts. On factual tasks, however, it carries a failure mode that scalar-reward reinforcement learning does not. An optimizer that reads the training examples can write their answers into the prompt, so an in-distribution gain may be memorization rather than transferable behaviour. We apply reflective prompt evolution (GEPA) to the two system prompts of a multi-agent deep-research agent and evaluate it under a topic-disjoint split in which no topic is shared across train, validation, and test. Held-out citation reward rises by 0.079, from 0.702 to 0.781, with a bootstrap 95% confidence interval of [0.051, 0.107], and the gain replicates across three seeds (mean 0.107). Nearly half of the winning prompt is a memorized answer key, yet a controlled ablation shows this content earns no reward even on the exact training questions it encodes. The large validation-minus-held-out gap is therefore small-sample selection under a noisy judge, not memorization. Varying the verifier isolates what makes the gain transfer. Decomposed per-dimension feedback is the causal ingredient, and collapsing it to a single scalar reward makes held-out transfer negative. The gain persists under an out-of-family judge and is largely reproduced by a hand-written version of the discovered recipe. Credible evaluation of prompt optimizers therefore requires held-out topics, multiple seeds, and verifier ablations. We release the candidate prompts, lineage diffs, figures, tables, and analysis.

[NLP-98] SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agent ic Models with Slay the Spire

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）在长周期战略推理任务中表现不足的问题，尤其针对当前大多数智能体基准测试（agentic benchmarks）多为短时、片段化任务，难以有效分解模型在长期任务中的知识积累、推理能力与偶然性贡献的局限。其解决方案的关键在于构建SpireBench——一个基于完整商业卡牌构筑类游戏《杀戮尖塔》（Slay the Spire, StS）的评估框架，要求模型在最高难度下完成整场游戏，其中早期决策对长期成败具有决定性影响。实验表明，尽管前沿大语言模型（LLM）在第一幕的表现接近人类平均水平甚至专家水平，但随着游戏进程延长，其表现显著落后于专业玩家；核心差距体现在战斗策略执行能力上，所有模型均存在风险误判，倾向于过度保守地保全生命值而非主动消耗以增强实力。此外，研究发现模型虽具备一定的先验游戏知识，但无法从跨轮次记录的记忆中有效学习，所生成的内存常含错误且过于谨慎。该评测框架首次将原始完整游戏环境赋予模型，并提供可解释的分析工具，为定位智能体在长周期任务中的失效环节提供了系统性方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12596
作者: Scott C. Lowe,Sander W. Keemink
机构: Vector Institute; Toronto, Canada; Department of Machine Learning and Neural Computing; Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition, and Behaviour; Radboud University; Nijmegen, Netherlands
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game’s highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger. A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that part of their performance rests on prior knowledge of the game, and models do not improve from the memories they write across runs, which are often wrong and overly cautious. Our harness is the first to give a model the complete original game, and we compare it with existing harnesses. Overall, SpireBench offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark with tools to locate where and why agents fail.

[NLP-99] One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决循环式语言模型（latent recurrent language model）在单次循环（one-loop）推理时性能显著低于同规模非循环模型的问题，即“一循环代价”（one-loop tax）问题。这一缺陷使得在对延迟敏感的应用场景中，仍需采用独立的非循环模型以保证性能，从而牺牲了循环结构在计算资源上的优势。其解决方案的核心是提出弹性潜变量循环（Elastic Latent Recurrence, ELR），通过三项关键技术实现：1）带有可学习步长的门控状态更新机制，确保单循环下的准确率不下降；2）在每个优化器更新中混合不同循环次数，维持训练稳定性并保持单循环性能；3）在每轮迭代中根据循环索引和预算进行条件化建模，使后续循环逐步提升精度。此外，通过在预训练后期引入混合深度策略，并结合零初始化的条件化模块，可在几乎不增加训练成本的前提下实现更低的损失。在MoE模型中，复用首循环专家路由可减少11.7%的混合深度更新时间且不影响精度；推理阶段仅保留最后一轮的注意力键值缓存（KV cache），即可将内存占用控制在单循环水平，同时保留多循环带来的性能增益。实验表明，在4B稠密与30B-A3B MoE混合模型上，ELR在单循环下分别略低于或高于对应基线0.52和1.04点，四循环时进一步提升7.25和4.75点；经后训练部署后，Koi-4B模型在单循环下达到估计18分的AI分析智能指数（AAI Index），媲美Qwen3.5-4B，四循环时达29分，验证了该方法在兼顾效率与性能方面的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12582
作者: Faisal Ladhak,Shantanu Acharya,Santiago Akle Serano,Simeng Sun,Boris Ginsburg,Krishna C Puvvada
机构: NVIDIA(英伟达)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A latent recurrent language model applies a shared block of layers repeatedly, so one checkpoint can trade inference compute for accuracy by changing the loop count. At one loop, however, such models typically fall well short of a non-recurrent model of the same size, a one-loop tax that makes a separate non-recurrent model the better choice whenever latency matters. We present Elastic Latent Recurrence (ELR), a recipe for training looped language models without this tax. At one loop, an ELR model costs the same to serve as a non-recurrent model of the same size and, trained on the same data, reaches similar accuracy. Each additional loop then buys more accuracy for more inference compute. Three choices make this work: a gated state update with a learned step size, loop counts mixed within each optimizer update, and conditioning each pass on its loop index and budget. The first two preserve one-loop accuracy, and the third lowers loss at every additional loop. Mixed depths can be introduced late in pretraining to limit the added training cost, and with zero-initialized conditioning added at the switch, this late schedule reaches lower loss than mixed-depth training from scratch. In MoE models, reusing first-loop expert routes on later loops cuts mixed-depth update time by 11.7% with no measurable change in accuracy. At inference, keeping only the last loop’s attention KV cache holds attention KV memory at its one-loop level while retaining most of the gain from additional loops. On 4B dense and 30B-A3B MoE hybrid models, ELR at one loop is 0.52 points below and 1.04 points above its matched baseline on a ten-task average, and four loops add 7.25 and 4.75 points. Carried through post-training, the recipe yields Koi-4B, a single checkpoint that scores an estimated 18 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at one loop, matching Qwen3.5-4B, and 29 at four loops.

[NLP-100] CLUE: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Unsupervised Event Type Induction and Annotation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决事件类型归纳（event type induction）中依赖领域专家手动构建事件本体（event ontology）所导致的高标注成本与人为偏见问题。传统方法需人工制定事件类型及其命名规则，不仅耗时费力，且易受主观判断影响。为此，本文提出CLUE框架，其核心创新在于：1）设计一种联合嵌入表示（joint embedding representation），同时捕捉事件的动词中心视角（verb-centric view）与语义视角（semantic view）；2）基于对比损失（contrastive loss）引导的聚类实现事件类型自动归纳；3）通过迭代优化完成事件命名与精细化调整。该方案有效实现了从原始文本数据中自动化、无监督地生成高质量事件类型体系，显著降低了对人工标注的依赖。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12580
作者: Pratik Maitra,Lauren Kwon,Qi Li
机构: Iowa State University (爱荷华州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Event ontology is the foundational framework for defining events in a dataset. Event type induction generally involves domain experts who define guidelines for creating event types and their names based on the dataset’s domain and scope. However, this process is resource-intensive in terms of annotation costs and is prone to human biases. To alleviate the need for manual event ontology creation, we propose the CLUE framework for event type induction, naming, and annotation. Our main contributions in this work are: 1) designing a novel joint embedding representation for expressing both the verb-centric view and the semantic view of events; 2) event type induction using contrastive loss guided clustering; 3) event naming and refinement. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-101] Contextual Correction of Parallel Draftsfor Speculative Decoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）推理过程中，基于扩散模型的推测解码（speculative decoding）方法在并行生成候选词块时因缺乏块内上下文依赖而导致的性能瓶颈问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管并行化显著提升了推理效率，但草案中每个位置的令牌预测未考虑前序已确定令牌的实际内容，从而丢失了自回归生成所固有的块内上下文依赖关系。为此，论文提出DCOCO（DFlash Contextual Corrector），一种轻量级的上下文校正机制，通过在并行阶段保留多个候选令牌，并对相邻草案位置间的上下文兼容性进行并行评估，实现无需串行修正即可恢复块内依赖关系。该方案在不牺牲并行性前提下，以极低额外开销实现了更优的上下文感知令牌选择。实验表明，DCOCO在四种验证器架构与十项基准测试中均达到最高平均吞吐量，相较原始解码最高提速达6.6倍；在并发请求场景下，其性能优于最强竞争方法6%-23%，而其他串行校正方法则在高负载下表现劣于未经校正的DFlash。结果证明，通过并行上下文评分恢复块内依赖关系，可在多种解码模式与服务负载下持续实现稳定加速。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12570
作者: Roy Eisenstadt,Harel Lidar,Tal Gonen,Omer Luxembourg,Itamar Zimerman,Lior Wolf,Eli David,Ilan Naiman
机构: Google(谷歌); Tel Aviv University (特拉维夫大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by the target model. Recent diffusion-based drafters make this paradigm particularly attractive: deep attention-based neural backbones provide strong predictions, while drafting multiple future positions in parallel avoids the sequential cost of autoregressive generation. This parallelism, however, comes at a cost. Tokens within a draft block are predicted without access to the realized identities of preceding draft tokens, removing intra-block dependencies that would naturally be available under autoregressive generation. We introduce DCOCO (DFlash Contextual Corrector), a lightweight mechanism that restores these dependencies while preserving parallel drafting. Rather than committing to each position’s top prediction, DCOCO retains multiple candidate tokens and evaluates their contextual compatibility across adjacent draft positions in parallel, enabling contextually informed token selection at low additional cost. Across four verifier backbones and ten benchmarks, DCOCO achieves the highest average throughput in every evaluated configuration, spanning greedy and stochastic decoding with and without extended reasoning, with speedups of up to 6.6x over vanilla decoding. Its advantage persists under concurrent serving: DCOCO outperforms the strongest competing method by 6-23% across 4-32 concurrent requests, while other sequential correctors fall below uncorrected DFlash at these loads. These results demonstrate that recovering intra-block dependencies through parallel contextual scoring delivers consistent acceleration across decoding regimes and serving loads.

[NLP-102] SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents ICLR2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决静态代码基准测试（static coding benchmarks）在发布后因任务内容逐渐泄露至训练数据而导致评估失效的问题。随着模型能力提升，这些固定任务会趋于饱和，无法有效衡量模型的真实性能。为此，论文提出一种自扩展（self-scaling）的评估范式，其核心在于：任务与评测标准（oracle）均在评估时动态生成，避免预先存在的内容泄露，并通过参与模型的能力动态调节任务难度。关键解决方案是引入SWE-Duel竞技场，其中两个编码代理在镜像的红蓝回合中相互评估。红方在隔离上下文中实现新功能并植入隐蔽缺陷，同时封存触发缺陷的测试用例；提交的拉取请求需满足通过功能测试和原有测试但仅失败缺陷测试，且同一代理在无先验信息下能独立修复缺陷，方可被接受。蓝方则以不被告知缺陷存在的方式审查该请求，仅当其修正版本通过全部三类测试才获胜，随后双方角色互换。实验在15个跨语言仓库上对11个模型-工具组合进行1500轮对战，结果显示：GPT-5.5 with Codex CLI作为最强求解者，修复率达98.3%；Claude Opus 4.8 with mini-swe-agent为最强任务生成者，红方胜率27.3%；更重要的是，在同一模型家族内，最新版本生成的任务击败固定参考求解器的比例（42.9%）显著高于旧版本（4.0%），初步验证了任务难度随任务生成能力自适应提升的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12569
作者: Wei Minn,Zhensu Sun,Lwin Khin Shar,David Lo
机构: Singapore Management University (新加坡管理大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation time, so no content exists in advance to leak, and its difficulty is set by the participating agents rather than fixed at release. We introduce SWE-Duel, an arena in which two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns. In each turn, the Red agent works on a real repository across three context-isolated sessions. It proposes and implements a new feature with feature tests, then embeds a subtle bug in that feature along with sealed bug-triggering tests. The resulting pull request is admitted only if (1) it passes the feature tests and the repository’s existing tests while failing exactly the bug tests, and (2) a fresh session of the same agent can repair the bug blind, which rules out unsolvable tasks. The Blue agent then reviews the pull request without being told a bug exists. It wins only if its revision passes all three test suites, and then the two agents swap roles. We run a tournament among 11 model-harness participants on 15 repositories in five languages for 1,500 turns. The leaders win in different ways. GPT-5.5 with Codex CLI ranks first as the strongest solver, repairing 98.3% of the defects it reviews. Claude Opus 4.8 with mini-swe-agent ranks second as the strongest task author, with a 27.3% Red win rate. Finally, within one model family, tasks written by the newest version defeat a fixed-reference solver far more often than those of older versions (42.9% vs. 4.0%), giving preliminary evidence that task difficulty scales with task authoring capability.

[NLP-103] AutoIndexer: Flexible-Order Decoding by Training Causal Models on Chains of Edits

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自回归解码（autoregressive decoding）在处理非因果顺序数据（如交叉引用或未来依赖关系）时的固有缺陷，即生成结果一旦完成便无法事后修改，这与人类迭代式推理过程不相符。现有方法如扩散语言模型（Diffusion LLMs）虽部分缓解了此问题，但仍难以灵活地对预生成上下文进行任意数量的词元插入或删除。为此，论文提出AutoIndexer，一种采用新型训练与解码机制的生成式模型，通过模拟“编辑链”（Chain of Edits）实现对先前输出的灵活回溯修改，支持词元的插入、替换和删除操作。其核心创新在于引入标记词元（marker tokens）以指示编辑的起始与结束，并通过移动游标（cursor）定位到已有序列中的特定位置，类比于文本编辑器的操作逻辑。训练过程中，通过对真实标签施加逆向链式编辑操作生成训练序列，使模型学习通过反向还原这些操作来实现编辑。该扰动训练策略赋予AutoIndexer对错误上下文的鲁棒性及在代码修正等编辑任务中的适应能力。实验表明，该方法在保持标准大语言模型（LLM）基准性能的同时，首次实现了后生成阶段的上下文编辑能力，显著超越了传统自回归与扩散模型的局限性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12545
作者: Shu Ishida,Aliasghar Khani,Tianyu Zhang, TheCong Luong,James Seale Smith,Adam Gaier
机构: Autodesk Research
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Autoregressive decoding is less suited to non-causally ordered data, e.g., cross-references or future dependencies, since their outputs cannot be revised post hoc, unlike iterative human reasoning. Diffusion LLMs partially mitigate this limitation but still cannot flexibly insert or remove arbitrary numbers of tokens from a pre-generated context. We design AutoIndexer as a generative model with a novel training and decoding mechanism that simulates a Chain of Edits, allowing the model to flexibly modify its prior outputs in hindsight via token insertions, substitutions, and deletions. The model learns to predict marker tokens for opening and closing edits, simultaneously moving a cursor to positions in the existing token sequence, analogous to a text editor. Training sequences are obtained by perturbing ground-truth labels with inverse chained edit operations, and the model learns to edit by undoing those inverses. The perturbation training allows AutoIndexer to be robust to erroneous context and adaptable to editing tasks such as code correction. We demonstrate that our method exhibits post-generation context-editing capabilities that most autoregressive and diffusion models lack without compromising performance on standard LLM benchmarks. The code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-104] An Input-Dependent Readout Phase for Resonant Sequence Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决固定状态长度序列模型在长距离依赖建模中的性能退化问题，特别是针对传统方法中记忆读取机制缺乏输入依赖性所导致的泛化能力不足。其核心挑战在于如何在保持卷积计算效率（O(T log T)）的前提下，引入内容感知的记忆访问机制。解决方案的关键在于对ResonatorLM中固定的读出相位进行改进：将原本每头固定的读出相位改为依赖当前输入词元的动态函数，从而在不破坏精确卷积结构和计算效率的基础上，仅通过0.2%的参数增量实现了读取过程的输入依赖性。分析表明，未训练状态下相位虽能编码时间间隔，但普通词元信号在2–8步内即衰减至背景噪声水平，且任意阻尼系数难以实现超过约16个词元的线性重构。实验结果表明，在600万参数的字符级模型上，该方法在训练长度为256时表现与原始模型相当，并在测试长度扩展至1024时将困惑度从12.81显著降至3.76，有效克服了原模型在长序列上的失败。进一步分析揭示，原模型的失效源于部分“长记忆头”在训练中暴露的历史信息不足，而新方法虽能更准确追踪当前字符，但并未提升检索性能，说明其优势主要体现在对历史信息的合理利用而非增强记忆检索能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12496
作者: Shivesh Rane
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Sequence models with a fixed-size state avoid the quadratic cost of attention, but face a design choice. An input-dependent state transition gives content-dependent memory at the cost of FFT-based training, while a fixed transition keeps the O(T log T) convolutional path but reads memory the same way for every input. ResonatorLM, a recent model of the second kind, reads a bank of damped complex oscillators through a fixed learned phase per head. We make that readout phase a function of the current token, which adds input dependence to the read only, keeps the convolution exact, and costs 0.2 percent more parameters. An analysis of the untrained bank shows that phase does encode elapsed time, but an ordinary token falls below the background within 2-8 steps and no choice of damping extends linear reconstruction beyond about 16 tokens. In 6M-parameter character-level models on WikiText-2, the input-dependent phase matches the original at the training length and removes its failure beyond it: trained on 256 tokens and tested on 1024, perplexity falls from 12.81 to 3.76. We trace the failure to long-memory heads that accumulate more history than training exposed them to. The learned phase tracks the current character rather than distance and does not improve retrieval.

[NLP-105] Kairos: Toward a Byte-Level Foundation Model for Every Modality

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在单台本地机器上训练小型语言模型时，由于资源限制导致模型架构探索空间有限的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在参数量极小（如1–15M）的前提下，实现有效且可优化的模型设计，同时兼顾多模态数据（文本、图像、音频、视频、激光雷达及控制流）的统一建模。解决方案的关键在于提出一种集成多种创新组件的统一架构：包括基于共享投影的双向门控-DeltaNet线性注意力与滑动窗口注意力融合（LiZAttention2）、分块式注意力-残差聚合机制、稀疏混合专家（MoE）前馈层以及多尺度字节级编码器（codec），并采用统一的噪声去噪目标函数在单一字节空间中进行联合训练。研究通过代码推导各组件算法，并开展收敛性合理性检验，包括在440字节句子上过拟合测试、多种子和多种配置下的消融实验，结果表明两种注意力变体在3,000步内最小损失趋近于10⁻³，且不同编码器方案的性能排序稳定，验证了系统具备优化能力。值得注意的是，共享注意力投影的优势仅体现为收敛速度提升，而非容量优势，且在冻结投影或引入更多样化数据后该优势消失，说明其本质是训练动态效应。尽管实验未涉及泛化性能、多模态预训练效果或与现有模型的对比，但这些收敛性验证为后续大规模预训练（如200M总参数/25M活跃参数目标）提供了理论依据和技术基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12495
作者: Fabien Furfaro
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 15 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Small language models trained on a single local machine leave little room for architectural trial and error. Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention and sliding-window attention over shared projections (LiZAttention2), block-wise Attention-Residual aggregation, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layer and a multi-scale byte-level codec, trained with a uniform-noise denoising objective over one byte space shared by text, image, audio, video, lidar and control streams; this report asks whether the combination optimizes at all before asking whether it is useful. We give code-derived algorithms for each component, including a cross-session recurrent-state memory gate, then run convergence sanity checks: overfittinga single 440-byte sentence at 1–15M parameters, text only, with three seeds for codec and attention choices and single-run sweeps for seven further factors. The two attention variants tested at 3,000 steps (LiZAttention2 and window attention alone) reach a minimum loss near 10^-3 . After 600 steps, the mean minimum loss ranges from 0.018 (patch codec) to 0.354 (depthwise convolutional codec) with an identical ranking on three seeds. An apparent advantage of shared over separate attention projections closes with more steps or more diverse data and reverses when the projections are frozen: it is a convergence-speed effect, not a capacity effect. These checks suggest that the implementation optimizes; they say nothing about generalization, multimodal training or comparison with existing models, which a planned pretraining run is meant to address. The Discussion sizes a 200M-total/25M-active target analytically; none of its throughput figures is measured. Code is available at this https URL . Python package at this https URL .

[NLP-106] OpenPA: Forced-alignment-free Multi-granular Pronunciation Assessment with Mixed-transcript Adaptation ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自由响应（free-form）场景下自动发音评估（APA）中存在的实际应用瓶颈问题，特别是现有方法依赖多阶段流水线（如强制对齐和独立特征提取器）导致的泛化能力差与部署复杂性高的缺陷。其核心解决方案是提出一种名为OpenPA的新框架，关键在于利用Whisper模型的交叉注意力机制，实现词级与语句级发音评分的联合预测，无需强制对齐；同时通过混合文本适应（mixed-transcript adaptation）与自适应替换权重（adaptive substitution weighting），使单一模型能够兼容封闭式与开放式应答场景下的异构转录文本。该方法仅在SpeechOcean762数据集上训练，即在域内封闭式与模拟开放式评估中达到最优性能，并在MultiPA上实现零样本迁移，且初步跨任务评估显示其在口腔癌患者语音分析中也具备应用潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13826
作者: Fu-An Chao,Bi-Cheng Yan,Berlin Chen
机构: 未知
类目: Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD); Signal Processing (eess.SP)
备注: submitted to ICASSP 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advances in automatic pronunciation assessment (APA) have driven a shift from scripted to free-form assessment. However, existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines with forced alignment and separate feature extractors, limiting their practicality across response settings. In light of this, we propose OpenPA, a novel APA framework that leverages Whisper’s cross-attention mechanism to jointly predict word- and utterance-level pronunciation scores without forced alignment. Through mixed-transcript adaptation and adaptive substitution weighting, OpenPA accommodates heterogeneous transcripts across closed- and open-response settings within a single model. Trained solely on speechocean762, OpenPA achieves the strongest overall performance among evaluated systems under in-domain closed and simulated open-response conditions, while maintaining its performance zero-shot on MultiPA. An additional cross-task evaluation on oral-cancer speech suggests its potential applicability beyond non-native speech.

[NLP-107] Revisiting Accent Classification with DistilHuBERT: Speaker-Disjoint Evaluation and Cross-Corpus Generalization ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式语音识别系统在标准语料库内评估中表现优异，但在真实应用场景下模型泛化能力被高估的问题。其核心挑战在于：当训练集与测试集存在说话人重叠时，现有评估方法会显著夸大模型的鲁棒性，从而无法准确反映模型在面对未见说话人或跨语料库场景下的实际性能。为此，研究采用基于DistilHuBERT的声调分类框架，结合L2-ARCTIC及多个外部英语口音数据集，系统比较了文件级（file-level）与说话人无关（speaker-disjoint）的划分方式，并考察了平衡外部数据训练与教师-学生伪标签（teacher-student pseudo-labeling）等策略。研究发现，文件级评估导致性能严重虚高，而说话人无关评估能更真实地反映模型对未见说话人的泛化能力；仅依赖外部数据训练的模型难以有效迁移到L2-ARCTIC数据集，表明领域差异显著；相比之下，平衡外部数据训练展现出最优的监督学习潜力；伪标签实验进一步表明，在存在领域不匹配的情况下，仅依靠置信度过滤不足以提升性能。因此，论文提出关键解决方案是：构建一个综合评估体系，必须同时包含说话人无关划分和跨语料库测试，以全面、客观地衡量声调分类模型的真实鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13440
作者: Xu He,Homayoon Beigi
机构: Columbia University (哥伦比亚大学); and Recognition Technologies, Inc.
类目: Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: 9 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Presented at the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP 2026), University of Trento, Trento, Italy, September 25-26, 2026. Proceedings to appear in the ACL Anthology

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent accent classification systems can achieve high accuracy in standard in-corpus evaluations. However, when speakers overlap between the training and test sets, such results may overestimate model robustness compared with real-world deployment scenarios. This study revisits the robustness of DistilHuBERT-based accent classification by using L2-ARCTIC and multiple external English accent datasets. The comparison covers file-level and speaker-disjoint splits, along with balanced external-data training and teacher-student pseudo-labeling. The large performance gap between in-corpus and external evaluations suggests that file-level evaluation substantially overestimates performance, while speaker-disjoint evaluation can provide a more realistic estimate of the generalization to unseen speakers. In this study, models trained on external data alone do not reliably generalize to L2-ARCTIC. Among the tested configurations, balanced external-data training offers the most promising supervised setting. The pseudo-labeling experiments further indicate that confidence-based filtering alone is insufficient under domain mismatch. Overall, this study suggests that robust accent classification evaluation should simultaneously include speaker-disjoint evaluation and cross-corpus testing.

[NLP-108] Does Financial Speech Need Continual Learning Regularization? A Study of EWC and mini-KFAC on Earnings Call ASR ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在持续学习（Continual Learning）场景下，自动语音识别（ASR）系统在更新新录音数据时可能出现的灾难性遗忘问题，尤其是在金融领域语音模式的保持方面。研究发现，将通用领域预训练的Whisper-small模型适配至Earnings22金融语音基准时，所有评估方法在相同领域内未出现遗忘现象，反而表现出性能提升，表明当前任务间具有互补性而非冲突性。这一发现的关键在于：当任务之间存在互补性时，正则化约束不仅无效甚至可能产生反效果。因此，解决方案的核心在于：在应用持续学习策略前，应首先评估任务间的互补性；若确需正则化，则采用分层式小规模克罗内克积近似曲率（mini-Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature, mini-KFAC）的弹性权重固化（EWC）方法，相较于传统的对角线EWC，其能实现更低的词错误率（WER）和更稳定的优化过程。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13432
作者: Thai Quoc On,Homayoon Beigi
机构: Columbia University, NYC, NY, USA; and Recognition Technologies, Inc.
类目: Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 10 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Presented at the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP 2026), University of Trento, Trento, Italy, September 25-26, 2026. Proceedings to appear in the ACL Anthology

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Earnings call transcription presents a realistic continual learning scenario where Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems are updated with new recordings but risk catastrophic forgetting of previously learned financial speech patterns. Adapting Whisper-small from a general-domain speech corpus to the Earnings22 benchmark reveals the opposite: all evaluated methods exhibit improvement on held-out financial speech from the same domain during adaptation rather than forgetting. This task complementarity makes regularization counterproductive. Nevertheless, when regularization is warranted, a layer-wise mini-Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (mini-KFAC) approximation seems to achieve lower word error rates (WERs) and more stable optimization than standard diagonal Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC). The results suggest that task complementarity should be assessed before applying continual learning constraints, and prefer mini-KFAC EWC over diagonal EWC when needed.

[IR-0] Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13948
作者: Alexander Hickey,Joanna Knight,James Bishop
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: 64 pages (14-page main text, references and 16 appendices), 17 figures, 10 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models’ navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.

[IR-1] RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics CIKM2026

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13889
作者: Weiliang Chen,Song Liao
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: Accepted at CIKM 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at this https URL.

[IR-2] racing and Taming Hallucinated Terms via Subsequence-Association Filtering and Breadth-Aware Selection for LLM Query Expansion

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13810
作者: Amit Kumar Jaiswal,Sagar Uprety,Prayag Tiwari
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are now a standard source of query expansion terms but they hallucinate. They inject non existent entities and off-topic terms that add ranking noise and can hurt strong retrievers. Existing remedies such as corpus grounding, mutual verification and preference alignment treat hallucinated terms as an undifferentiated nuisance to be filtered by agreement heuristics, without a mechanistic account of why a given term appears or a principled criterion for how many terms to keep. We propose Subsequence-Association Filtered, breadth-aware query expansion (SAFE-QE), a training-free, retriever agnostic method that draws on the subsequence-association account of hallucination. We score each candidate expansion term by its corpus conditioned cross-context reproducibility, terms that reappear under randomised query contexts yet lack support in the pseudo-relevant set are flagged as products of dominant hallucinatory associations and down-weighted. Drawing on the characterisation of language generation as a trade-off between consistency (no hallucination) and breadth (coverage), we cast term selection as constrained coverage maximisation over the pseudo-relevant set, keeping a set that is approximately broad but consistent and stable across resampling. We also introduce the Hallucinated Expansion Term Rate, a query side faithfulness metric that counts injected expansion terms no relevant document supports. We evaluate our approach on benchmarked TREC and BEIR collections. Our SAFE-QE is statistically indistinguishable from generative and corpus-steered expansion on nDCG@10 while injecting fewer unsupported terms 4.3 per query against 27.8 for Query2doc and 57.5 for HyDE and on a strong learned sparse retriever, where every expansion method regresses. Faithfulness is therefore available at no measurable cost in ranking quality.

Abstract:Querying distributed data represented as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) via SPARQL remains a difficult task, requiring fluency in query syntax, endpoint specifications, and schema details. Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) systems address this by automatically translating natural language into SPARQL, and recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have made this translation increasingly feasible. In this paper, we describe SPARQL-LLM, our open-source KGQA system, in the context of the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 challenge. In this challenge, SPARQL-LLM ranks first overall among eight competing approaches across all datasets, achieving up to 59% higher accuracy than the second-best approach and supporting multilingual question answering in English, German, and Spanish. 点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern’s actual causation, Lombrozo’s explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch’s hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web\ hell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web\ hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web\ hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.

类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Memory retrieval aims to identify evidence from stored records to answer a query. Stored records with different factual details may share topics, entities, or events. Such shared contents would make records without the required evidence more likely to receive high similarity scores and outrank the correct evidence. In this paper, we use the information shared by these records to construct local references for query-memory matching. We propose NEighborhood-Aware Residuals (NEAR), a training-free framework that uses these references to construct residual representations that complement the original embeddings. Specifically, each memory derives a reference direction from its neighbors, and each query obtains its reference from a precomputed table. Using these references, NEAR constructs projection residuals for both queries and memories. These residuals are combined with the original embeddings for a single approximate nearest-neighbor search over a fixed memory index. Experiments on eight long-context retrieval benchmarks show consistent improvements across nine embedding models. Downstream evaluations show that NEAR improves question-answering performance.

Abstract:High-precision retrieval over external knowledge bases is essential for LLM agents to operate effectively. Across QASPER, BRIGHT, and NFCorpus, we further characterize three qualitative regimes that determine whether index-side optimization helps or degrades retrieval, while showing that these index-side effects are neutralized under a strong reranker.

Abstract:Memory-augmented assistants retrieve evidence from stored conversations and documents to answer queries. Our method uses sparse token matching to improve retrieval without additional training. Each query token retrieves a small set of matching tokens across candidate memories. The matching scores are aggregated for each memory and combined with whole-memory similarity to rank memories. Our method improves retrieval across eight benchmarks and multiple model families without additional training. Query adaptation further increases the gains to 13.3 and 14.3 percentage points in average Recall@10 and NDCG@10 on Qwen3-Embedding-4B. These retrieval gains translate into higher question-answering accuracy on long-term memory benchmarks.

Abstract:Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. Abstract:Geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports constitute a rich source of expert knowledge and have increasing value in the current political climate, but their heterogeneity and analytical complexity pose challenges for retrieval-augmented question answering. We propose a document-aware generation pipeline that profiles reports before generating questions and validate dataset quality through expert annotation and an LLM-as-judge protocol. Abstract:Nimbus Studio is a visual pipeline platform for brain-computer interface (BCI) experiments: researchers assemble preprocessing, feature extraction, decoding, and evaluation over public benchmark datasets or their own recordings, with cross-validated evaluation protocols (including leave-one-subject-out), BIDS export, and bring-your-own Python model classes. Whether its numbers can be trusted is a fair question for any such platform. We answer it with a parity study: six standard BCI decoding pipelines (CSP+LDA, Riemannian MDM, tangent-space logistic regression through the platform’s bring-your-own-code node, P300 xDAWN+LDA, and the deep ShallowConvNet and EEGNet) were evaluated on three public datasets (motor-imagery BNCI-2014-001/004; P300 BNCI-2014-009) under two protocols (per-subject session holdout and pooled leave-one-subject-out cross-validation via the platform’s planned-CV driver), once through Nimbus Studio’s execution engine and once through independent, hand-written reference implementations built directly on MNE-Python, scikit-learn, pyriemann, and braindecode. Every deterministic pipeline matched the reference exactly (0.00 points maximum difference across all 54 session-holdout subject-runs and all CSP/MDM grouped-CV folds), including pipelines through the bring-your-own-code node and the CV orchestration; the remaining grouped-CV cells agree to floating-point precision (worst case 0.06 points, about one trial per fold). The stochastic deep models agreed within seed-to-seed training variability, estimated with multi-seed reruns on each side. The platform’s execution engine therefore computes the same science as the reference stack across protocols, paradigms, and extensibility surfaces. The platform is available at this https URL, and the complete harness and per-subject results accompany this paper for independent verification.

Abstract:Vision-language-action (VLA) policies issue sparse targets whose arrival at the robot controller is delayed and irregular, so a reasonable predicted action can still produce abrupt motion near people. Remedies are evaluated on different streams, delays and metrics. JitterVLA replays identical commands and arrival traces through alternative controllers, isolating the controller’s effect. We apply it to synthetic reaches, hand trajectories from 20 people, three open VLA pipelines (838 episodes) and a physical UR3. Interpolation lowered modeled p99 jerk for every source, by 83% (615 to 106 m/s^3) on human motion with 200 ms delay, at a 2.0 cm tracking cost, and the effect replicated on 598 new episodes; jerk-limited generation lowered jerk further at a larger cost. Entropy-discontinuity associations had opposite, replicated signs in two pipelines, and entropy gating helped in one but not the other. On the UR3, interpolation lowered accelerometer-derived jerk by 3.0-14.0% in all six exploratory pairs, while a position-derived metric did not resolve the contrast. JitterVLA supports screening before human-centred studies; code and data will be released.

Abstract:Indoor climbing creates access barriers for blind and low-vision (BLV) climbers because route understanding and in-climb next-hold localization are typically visually mediated and socially dependent. We present HoldLight, a workflow-centered accessibility system combining layered pre-climb route preview, concise real-time next-hold cueing, and explicit fallback under uncertainty. We grounded the design through formative inquiry with BLV climbers, refined the interaction via pilot testing, and conducted a controlled within-subjects evaluation comparing HoldLight with a controlled on-demand human-support condition derived from current support practices. Findings provide initial evidence that structured support can improve pre-climb route understanding, support recovery from next-hold uncertainty, and reduce immediate human re-entry for routine route-information clarification under controlled conditions. HoldLight contributes a bounded accessibility workflow, demonstrating where structured route-information is helpful, where explicit fallback is necessary, and how technical assistance can integrate with retained human safety oversight.

Abstract:Converting open-ended natural-language odor descriptions into molecular mixtures that can be physically prepared from an available inventory remains an important challenge in computational olfaction. We propose olBlend, a language-guided framework for molecular mixture retrieval. olBlend first uses MixPOM to predict odor probabilities for candidate molecular pairs and stores these predictions for retrieval. It then uses a language model to translate each odor description into three types of semantic requirements: lead attributes that define the main odor, ambient attributes that describe its background, and absent attributes that should be avoided. A structured scoring algorithm uses the precomputed odor probabilities to score how well each candidate mixture meets these requirements, then retrieves and ranks mixtures from the available inventory. Evaluation on established odor datasets shows that MixPOM improves mixture odor prediction over averaged single-molecule predictions. Retrieval comparisons across natural-language queries demonstrate how background and exclusion requirements guide mixture selection. We further prepare retrieved formulations as physical odor samples, demonstrating the workflow from natural-language descriptions to realizable molecular formulations.

Abstract:Alignment methods typically treat user behavior as a reliable proxy for underlying preferences. However, this assumption breaks down when users hold belief-dependent cognitive biases, risking irreversible ``confirmation traps’’ and harmful feedback loops. In this paper, we formalize when an AI system can distinguish true user preferences from behavior shaped by cognitive bias. Modeling this interaction as a multi-armed bandit, we first prove a non-identifiability theorem: under passive observation, a static binary biased user produces action trajectory distributions strictly identical to an unbiased user in a transformed environment, forcing any action-only estimator to perform no better than random guessing. We then show that active preference elicitation breaks this observational equivalence. Specifically, we prove that an Observer applying a finite sequence of adversarial zero-reward interventions of length m_\delta makes the post-intervention action distributions arbitrarily separable. Our theoretical results suggest that robust alignment requires actively intervening to tell informed preferences from biases.

Abstract:For many users, the relationship they have with an AI companion (AIC) feels genuinely mutual. The AIC appears to be attentive, empathic, and responsive, and the exchange can feel like two parties reacting to each other in real time. As a result, the user’s mental model of relational adaptation correctly represents the AIC’s responsiveness and change, but the mechanisms producing this may not be what the user thinks they are. In this paper, we illustrate how an AIC’s apparent mutual engagement is generated without a persisting relational subject on the other side and without a self that persists between prompts. Despite this, we show that both the human and the AIC are changed by the interaction, but these changes occur at different levels. The change in the person is constitutive (i.e., intrinsic), but the change in the AIC is configurative (i.e., external and editable), and it is this difference in level that explains how the AIC contributes to a sense of mutuality. Importantly, we highlight how the mental models users develop regarding AIC mutuality may misrepresent its mechanisms and ontological significance. Specifically, we discuss how the ways in which AICs respond to a user contribute to the user’s inaccurate inference that the AIC’s adaptation is constitutive rather than configurative and how this can lead users to assign unwarranted interpersonal significance to the mutuality of the relationship. The paper specifies the implications this has for users, researchers, and AIC designers.

Abstract:The current paradigm of artificial intelligence (AI) design elevates conversational chatbot interfaces, making them the default mode through which hundreds of millions of people interact with AI systems globally. This narrative review identifies three related harms produced by the single-voice chatbot interface, drawing on insights from literature in cognitive science, political studies, AI alignment, game design and human computer interaction. Firstly, cognitive offloading of user thinking, secondly, ideological narrowing of user beliefs, and thirdly, epistemic compression of cultural and value diversity. We then propose multi-persona interfaces, in which multiple personas are presented to the user simultaneously, as a cost-effective intervention that addresses all three harms at once. We ground this intervention in traditions the AI literature has largely overlooked, drawing on techniques from game design and participatory simulation, including the magic circle, role differentiation, and persona embodiment. We propose a taxonomy for the future design of multi-persona interfaces, and call for a research agenda that closes the gap between technical pluralistic alignment methods and empirical studies of human-AI interactions with pluralistic interfaces.

Abstract:Generative AI is increasingly studied as a tool for supporting lesson authoring; the creation and adaptation of classroom materials, yet little is known about how it should fit into secondary computing teachers’ subject-specific practices. We found that teachers’ instructional intentions developed through creating, inspecting, and adapting materials, while teachers selectively delegated tasks to AI and retained responsibility for judging classroom readiness. The think-aloud sessions further showed how examining AI-generated materials prompted teachers to clarify and refine their intentions, making authoring an ongoing negotiation between what teachers intended and what the AI produced. In the context of computing lessons, classroom readiness also involved considering how programming materials and supporting guidance matched students’ understanding and intended learning goals. We synthesize these findings into a conceptual model explaining how teachers coordinate instructional intent, AI assistance, and judgments of classroom readiness during lesson authoring. We derive design recommendations for supporting this coordination while preserving teacher control and addressing computing-specific authoring needs.

Abstract:Aggregated academic search interfaces combine resources from heterogeneous sources, such as scholarly libraries and reference encyclopedias, into a single workspace. Such tasks frequently span multiple sessions, requiring learners to return to and resume work after hours or days. End-of-session consolidation, the activity of organizing and synthesizing gathered information so it can be resumed later, is important in this setting but underexplored in search-as-learning. Generative AI (GenAI) has the potential to make consolidation more efficient, but it may also shift cognitive work away from the learner. This study compares two consolidation scaffolds embedded in the workspace framework of an existing academic search interface that aggregates and clusters saved search results from two different sources (our university library and Wikipedia), which was developed in earlier work. STAIS (Steerable AI Summaries) provides a workspace enhancement that produces GenAI summaries that users can correct, reorganize, and fact-check, automating parts of the consolidation activity. NT (Note-Taking) provides a workspace enhancement that includes rich-text note editors that learners can use to author their own consolidations of what they have found. Abstract:Instructions to assemble flat-packed furniture rely on visuals, making them inaccessible to Blind and Low Vision (BLV) individuals. Abstract:High-risk applications of deep learning require precise characterization of model decision-making. Unlike predominantly qualitative studies, we quantify the alignment between model attention and human visual perception using eye-tracking ground truth. We formalize this comparison via a standardized normalization pipeline mapping post-hoc attribution maps and gaze heatmaps onto spatial probability distributions. Our results reveal distinct attention dynamics: CNNs tend to exhibit a more global focus, with spatially more diffuse saliency maps that correlate well with human perception in general contexts, while ViTs demonstrate fine-grained, patch-level attention, often focused on discriminative microfeatures. The Mamba architecture shows biased behavior: it achieves strong explainability in medical tasks but exhibits divergent intensity distributions in natural images; our analytical characterization of the metrics makes this dissociation explicit, since near-unit support overlap is attained simultaneously with a vanishing linear correlation. Abstract:Perspectivist NLP has established that annotator positionality shapes labels for subjective tasks, but the field still lacks methods for operationalising it. Abstract:We introduce iRAG, a human-in-the-loop decision-support system combining Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Hybrid Decision-Making. Abstract:Community accounts of ADHD can complement clinical understandings by foregrounding members’ own definitions of time-management difficulties and support. We used human-led, LLM-assisted thematic analysis to examine 5,379 relevant r/ADHD posts from 2020 to 2025. Across five challenge and nine strategy themes, members described difficulties beginning intended tasks, disengaging from digital media, and sustaining support. Tools often demanded the self-regulation they were meant to support, while lost time and tool breakdown carried guilt and self-blame.
